arrival.afterworld.affinity_gift: %s comes back to you a fifth sooner, and its shard glows upon your chest.
arrival.afterworld.garb.head: Head
arrival.afterworld.garb_help.accent: The lantern belt glows faintly in the dark.
arrival.afterworld.garb_help.cloak: Cloaks catch the wind as you move. A cloak replaces any cape you own.
arrival.afterworld.garb_help.cloth: The main colour of everything you wear.
arrival.afterworld.garb_help.emblem: Embroidered on your cloak, and pinned to your chest.
arrival.afterworld.garb_help.feet: Boots cover cuffs; leggings cover wraps.
arrival.afterworld.garb_help.head: Helmets hide whatever you wear on your head.
arrival.afterworld.garb_help.random: Press Enter until something feels like you.
arrival.afterworld.garb_help.wear: Plain clothes show only your skin, and hide your shard.
arrival.afterworld.later_help: You will arrive without a discipline and can choose one from your Journal whenever you are ready. Your first Edict will have to be found.
arrival.afterworld.name_help: Type a name, or press Enter to keep the one you came with.
arrival.afterworld.name_keep: Press Enter when it sounds right.
arrival.afterworld.q.intro: ...A traveller wakes at the edge of the world.
arrival.afterworld.q.name: What is your name?
arrival.afterworld.q.outro: ...and the world begins to remember you.
arrival.afterworld.summary.name: Called %s.
arrival.afterworld.summary.undecided: Has not yet decided how to meet trouble.
arrival.afterworld.title: Traveller's Arrival
art.afterworld.avalanche.desc: Leap and come down as an avalanche: ice erupts in a line ahead of you, freezing and throwing everything it touches.
art.afterworld.avalanche.passive: Hits chill; frozen foes take half again as much damage.
art.afterworld.chain_pull.desc: Cast the chain in a sweeping arc: every foe in front of you is dragged into one heap, then blinded by a burst of sand.
art.afterworld.chakram.desc: Throw the chakram: it leaps from foe to foe (three, then five) and returns to your hand.
art.afterworld.chakram.passive: Hits sometimes send a shard into a second foe.
art.afterworld.cinder_cleave.desc: Leap forward and come down in a ring of fire that scorches and throws everything near.
art.afterworld.cinder_cleave.lore: A greatsword with an ember for a heart. It is never quite cool to the touch.
art.afterworld.coil_slam.desc: Let the mainspring go: everything around you is thrown into the air and slowed.
art.afterworld.coil_slam.lore: Wound tight. Do not stand too close when it unwinds.
art.afterworld.crimson_reap.desc: One wide crimson sweep: you heal for part of the damage, and anything it kills rises as a thrall to fight for you.
art.afterworld.crimson_reap.passive: Each hit mends you a little.
art.afterworld.crystal_fan.desc: Fling a fan of five living-crystal shards.
art.afterworld.crystal_fan.lore: It hums when the wind crosses its blade.
art.afterworld.crystal_fan.passive: Long reach. Hits sometimes burst, hurting foes close by.
art.afterworld.fang_flurry.desc: Dart forward and open whatever you reach with a flurry of quick cuts (more as the Fang grows).
art.afterworld.fang_flurry.lore: The wayfarer's answer to being cornered.
art.afterworld.frost_lance.desc: Lunge forward through everything in your way, freezing what you pass.
art.afterworld.frost_lance.lore: Its point is colder than the north wind.
art.afterworld.frost_lance.passive: Long reach. Hits frost the target.
art.afterworld.glyph_beam.desc: Brace behind the aegis and pour out a beam of judgment for two seconds. You take half damage while it burns.
art.afterworld.glyph_beam.passive: Hits sometimes brand a foe for extra radiant damage. It blocks like a shield.
art.afterworld.harpoon.desc: Fire the harpoon up to 24 blocks (32 when Awakened): spear a creature and haul it in, or spear a wall and haul yourself there. Sneak to go to the creature instead.
art.afterworld.harpoon.lore: Point at where you want to be.
art.afterworld.label: Art: %s  (right-click, %ss)
art.afterworld.lantern_cuts.desc: Blink behind up to three foes in front of you and cut each; each cut leaves a ghost lantern that bursts in soul fire a heartbeat later.
art.afterworld.lantern_cuts.lore: Three draws too quick to see.
art.afterworld.lantern_cuts.passive: Hits set foes alight with ghost-fire.
art.afterworld.rally.desc: Plant the banner for ten seconds: allies near it gain strength, resistance and regeneration; foes near it weaken and slow.
art.afterworld.rally.lore: Plant it, and the line holds.
art.afterworld.rally.passive: Each hit wraps you in a little ashen courage (absorption, up to two hearts).
art.afterworld.reel.desc: Hook what you look at and haul it to you. Sneak to haul yourself to it instead.
art.afterworld.reel.lore: Barbed backward, so nothing it holds slips free.
art.afterworld.riposte.desc: Take a stance for a heartbeat. Anything that strikes you is countered for triple damage and stunned; if nothing does, you lunge.
art.afterworld.riposte.lore: Taught in the Moonsilver Court, where duels end in one touch.
art.afterworld.riposte.passive: Every third hit in a row on the same foe flourishes into a second cut.
art.afterworld.spore_lash.desc: Crack the whip in a line: everything it reaches is poisoned and dragged toward you, and a spore cloud lingers where it ends.
art.afterworld.step_behind.desc: Step out of an echo behind what you look at. Your next blow on it lands twice.
art.afterworld.step_behind.lore: A dagger that is always a half-step behind the world.
art.afterworld.step_behind.passive: Every hit echoes a moment later.
art.afterworld.stopped_moment.desc: Stop the moment around you: every foe nearby freezes, and you move quickly.
art.afterworld.stopped_moment.lore: The King of Seconds kept time with it.
art.afterworld.stopped_moment.passive: Blows on stopped foes land half again as hard.
art.afterworld.thunderclap.desc: Clap: a cone of thunder strikes, stuns and hurls back everything in front of you, and lightning finds the closest.
art.afterworld.thunderclap.passive: Every fourth hit in a row arcs lightning to another foe.
art.afterworld.toll.desc: Ring one great toll: everything nearby is struck, thrown back and stopped for a moment.
art.afterworld.toll.lore: Struck from the Bell-Ringer's own bell.
art.afterworld.toll.passive: Hits sometimes stop a foe in its tracks.
art.afterworld.way_of_light.desc: Glide forward along a road of light, scattering foes; it mends you and your allies when it ends.
art.afterworld.way_of_light.lore: It has walked further than any road.
art.afterworld.way_of_light.passive: Every hit mends you a little.
aspect.afterworld.chains_of_the_dune.des: A sand vortex drags foes to its eye while stone fists fall on it.
aspect.afterworld.chains_of_the_dune.hin: Wake the Dune Sentinel under the Sun Temple in the Hourglass Dunes.
aspect.afterworld.footsteps_of_stone.des: Become a stone colossus for twelve seconds: huge, armoured and strong, and every step a quake.
aspect.afterworld.footsteps_of_stone.hin: Taken from the Pilgrim who walks where there are no roads.
aspect.afterworld.glyph_of_judgment.desc: A golden dome turns arrows and spells back for eight seconds; then judgment strikes every foe in sight.
aspect.afterworld.glyph_of_judgment.hint: Set five Glyph Tablets into the Gilded Vault's gate and stand before its Warden.
aspect.afterworld.hundred_lanterns.desc: Dash through up to eight foes in ghost-fire, cutting each, then return to where you stood.
aspect.afterworld.hundred_lanterns.hint: Win it from the Ashen Shogun, who waits in the Lantern Dojo among the blossoms.
aspect.afterworld.label: Aspect: %s
aspect.afterworld.red_dominion.desc: Four crimson knights rise to fight for you, and every wound you deal mends you.
aspect.afterworld.red_dominion.hint: Break the Crimson Lich's three phylacteries, then face him in his necropolis.
aspect.afterworld.requiem_toll.desc: A spectral bell falls where you look: everything under it is struck hard, stunned and sickened.
aspect.afterworld.requiem_toll.hint: Taken from the Bell-Ringer of the Hollow Cathedral.
aspect.afterworld.stopped_hour.desc: Time stops for everything around you but you: creatures freeze and arrows hang in the air for five seconds.
aspect.afterworld.stopped_hour.hint: Taken from the King of Seconds in his vault.
aspect.afterworld.use: Use to bind this Aspect. Fill its Resonance in battle, then unleash it (C).
aspect.afterworld.white_winter.desc: A blizzard dome: everything inside slows, freezes and bleeds cold for ten seconds.
aspect.afterworld.white_winter.hint: Find the Rimeback Colossus's den in the Whitewaste.
block.afterworld.waystone.desc: Touch it to remember it. Use any waystone you know to travel to another.
board.afterworld.desc.bounty: Last seen %s, %s. It does not hunt alone.
board.afterworld.desc.escort: Raiders have a caravan pinned down on a road nearby. See it through.
board.afterworld.desc.survey: Three sightings for the Guild. The first: %s, %s.
board.afterworld.empty: Nothing is pinned up today. Come back tomorrow.
board.afterworld.none_carried: Take a notice from the board. You can carry three at once.
board.afterworld.status.delivery_need: Carrying %s of %s. Buy them where they are cheap.
board.afterworld.title: The Warden's Board
bond.afterworld.landlord.obligation: Rent: 3 emeralds every 3 days, taken at dawn if you carry them.
bond.afterworld.landlord.service: Tenancy: once per rent period, a killing blow leaves you standing with three hearts.
bond.afterworld.landlord.terms: Service: once per rent period he will not let you die on his premises. Obligation: 3 emeralds every 3 days.
bond.afterworld.moth.obligation: Feed it 2 glowstone dust or 4 torches each day.
bond.afterworld.moth.service: Night sight in darkness; invisible creatures nearby glow.
bond.afterworld.moth.terms: Service: sight in the dark, and the invisible revealed. Obligation: 2 glowstone dust or 4 torches every day.
bond.afterworld.pilgrim.obligation: Visit a mended shrine every 5 days.
bond.afterworld.pilgrim.service: You step up whole blocks and walk faster on paths.
bond.afterworld.pilgrim.terms: Service: sure feet and swift paths. Obligation: visit a mended shrine every 5 days.
boss.afterworld.ashen_shogun.epithet: Every lantern is a life he took.
boss.afterworld.ashen_shogun.wakes: The Ashen Shogun opens his eyes. The lanterns of the dojo flare blue.
boss.afterworld.crimson_lich.epithet: He hid his heart in three places.
boss.afterworld.crimson_lich.revive: The Lich rises again. His phylacteries still bind him to the world.
boss.afterworld.crimson_lich.wakes: The Crimson Lich turns his skull toward you.
boss.afterworld.dune_sentinel.wakes: Sand pours from the Sentinel's shoulders as it wakes. WHO WAKES THE SUN?
boss.afterworld.gilded_warden.wakes: The gate swings wide. Gold light runs along the Warden's shell as it rises to judge you.
character.afterworld.aspects_intro: Aspects are the hearts of the old powers. Defeat a great power to take its heart, bind it, fill its Resonance by fighting well, then unleash it (C).
character.afterworld.edict_intro: Raise an Edict with Edict Shards and Marks. You carry %s shards.
character.afterworld.equip_cost: Changing Aspects scatters half your Resonance.
character.afterworld.needs_previous: Learn the skill above it first.
character.afterworld.no_edicts: You have learned no Edicts yet. Anomalies and shrines hold them.
character.afterworld.no_set: Wear all four pieces of a set to wake its bonus.
character.afterworld.rank_effect: Rank %s: each rank makes it recover 15%% faster and bend its rule 30%% harder.
character.afterworld.relics_how: Use a relic to wear it. Click a worn relic to take it off.
clue.afterworld.glyph: A glyph carved into the stone, still warm. The same mark is on every glyph tablet.
clue.afterworld.manifest: The caravan's manifest. Spice, silk, water... and a last line in a hurried hand: "The obelisk. Hide."
clue.afterworld.note: A note, half washed out: "...the key turns at noon..."
clue.afterworld.tracks: Footprints, many, heading south and east into the dunes, toward the old obelisk. Something larger followed.
clue.afterworld.tracks.short: Read the tracks in the sand.
clue.afterworld.wagon: A wagon wheel, snapped clean through. Not by a storm: the spokes were cut. Whoever stopped this caravan meant to.
codex.afterworld.anomaly.choice.desc: Breaking an anomaly’s core seals it for good, and the Bureau approves. Tapping it with a glass bottle yields residue; after enough taps it spills its Edict and spreads.
codex.afterworld.anomaly.echoes.desc: Inside this anomaly, every strike you land is echoed.
codex.afterworld.anomaly.forgotten.desc: Inside this anomaly, creatures forget you are there.
codex.afterworld.anomaly.hospitality.des: Inside this anomaly, creatures treat you as a guest.
codex.afterworld.anomaly.hunger.desc: Inside this anomaly, the foes you defeat rise as echoes.
codex.afterworld.anomaly.return.desc: Inside this anomaly, whatever you drop comes back to you.
codex.afterworld.anomaly.sealed.desc: You sealed an anomaly. Its rule is yours now, and the land around it is quieter.
codex.afterworld.anomaly.stillness.desc: Inside this anomaly, hostile creatures move slowly.
codex.afterworld.anomaly.tapped.desc: You drew residue from a living anomaly. It noticed.
codex.afterworld.anomaly.tapped.hint: Bring a glass bottle to an anomaly core.
Inside this anomaly you fall slowly and leap high.
codex.afterworld.anomaly.witness.desc: Inside this anomaly, every creature nearby is revealed.
codex.afterworld.bond.landlord.desc: Tenancy: once per rent period, a killing blow leaves you standing with three hearts. Rent: 3 emeralds every 3 days, taken at dawn if you carry them. Neglect brings a complication, never a silent penalty.
codex.afterworld.bond.landlord.hint: A principled ghost, behind on his rent.
codex.afterworld.bond.landlord.tenancy.d: The Ghost Landlord kept you alive. He will not do it again until the rent is paid.
codex.afterworld.bond.landlord.tenancy.h: A landlord who cares about his premises.
codex.afterworld.bond.moth.desc: Night sight in darkness; invisible creatures nearby glow. Feed it 2 glowstone dust or 4 torches each day. Neglect brings a complication, never a silent penalty.
codex.afterworld.bond.moth.hint: Keep a hungry lantern lit long enough.
codex.afterworld.bond.pilgrim.desc: You step up whole blocks and walk faster on paths. Visit a mended shrine every 5 days. Neglect brings a complication, never a silent penalty.
codex.afterworld.bond.pilgrim.hint: Help the Pilgrim finish its walk.
codex.afterworld.boss.ashen_shogun.desc: Once the gentlest of men, he swore to guard the blossom country forever, and the world took him at his word. He cuts, dashes in lines of ghostfire and throws lanterns that fall where you stand. Parry his iaido.
codex.afterworld.boss.bell_ringer.counte: A release in the cathedral loft drops the great chandelier on whatever stands beneath it.
codex.afterworld.boss.bell_ringer.desc: A hunched giant that drags a great bell through the Hollow Cathedral. Each ring silences one of your Edicts.
codex.afterworld.boss.bell_ringer.hint: Something drags a bell in the cathedral.
codex.afterworld.boss.bell_ringer.name: A Forgotten Name
codex.afterworld.boss.bell_ringer.name.d: The Bell-Ringer once had a name. Written on a name tag and offered to it, a name could end the fight without a death.
codex.afterworld.boss.bell_ringer.name.h: Ledgers in the cathedral archive remember part of it.
codex.afterworld.boss.bell_ringer.rift.d: Caught in a Weightlessness rift, the Bell-Ringer topples and takes half again as much damage while it struggles up.
codex.afterworld.boss.bell_ringer.rift.h: Heavy things hate losing their footing.
codex.afterworld.boss.bell_ringer.stolen: When the Bell-Ringer throws its bell, Return can take it. Without the bell it cannot silence you, but it grows angrier.
What returns to whoever calls it?
codex.afterworld.boss.crimson_lich.desc: A theatrical old king who hid his life in three phylacteries. Blood beams, a red nova, the dead raised to fight for him, a drain that feeds on you. Break all three phylacteries, or he rises again.
codex.afterworld.boss.crimson_lich.hint: Sister Ines knows where he hid his heart.
codex.afterworld.boss.dune_sentinel.desc: A sand golem asleep under the Sun Temple, its fists floating on chains. They fall where you stand; its chains drag you in; then the sand itself turns round it.
codex.afterworld.boss.dune_sentinel.hint: Something sleeps under the Sun Temple.
codex.afterworld.boss.gilded_warden.desc: The last guardian, a turtle of stone whose shell is written in gold. Beams of glyph-light, a rolling shell, a golden dome that turns arrows back, and at the end, judgment on the whole vault.
codex.afterworld.boss.gilded_warden.hint: Five glyph tablets open the Gilded Vault.
codex.afterworld.boss.king.bargain.desc: Brought low, the King may offer a fragment of his power in exchange for his life. Hold out a clock and sneak-use him to accept.
codex.afterworld.boss.king.bargain.hint: Kings always have something to trade.
codex.afterworld.boss.king.desc: A clockwork monarch who locks his challengers into loops of their own movement. Every escapement left standing keeps him on time.
codex.afterworld.boss.king.hint: He waits at the bottom of the Vault of Seconds.
codex.afterworld.boss.lich.phylactery.de: The Crimson Lich hid his life in three phylacteries: a barrow on the Vesper Downs, an ossuary in the Pale Reach, and his own necropolis. Break all three, or he will not stay down.
codex.afterworld.boss.lich.phylactery.hi: Sister Ines knows where the Lich hid his heart.
codex.afterworld.boss.pilgrim.desc: A colossal stone pilgrim that walks between four shrines without touching the ground. It rarely attacks first. Its footsteps wear roads into the grass.
codex.afterworld.boss.pilgrim.hint: Shepherds speak of a walking statue.
codex.afterworld.boss.pilgrim.peace.desc: With its shrines mended, the Pilgrim finished its walk and knelt. Its road now walks with whoever helped it.
A horned giant of the Whitewaste with ice growing from its back. It swipes, slams the ground into rolling waves (jump them), throws boulders of ice and breathes frost. At the end, it brings a blizzard.
Torvald has seen tracks as wide as a cart.
codex.afterworld.combo.ambush.desc: While Forgotten and Witnessing, your strikes on revealed creatures deal double damage.
codex.afterworld.combo.ambush.hint: Be unseen by what you can see.
codex.afterworld.combo.echoed_edict.desc: Casting any Edict during an Echoes window repeats it a moment later at reduced strength.
codex.afterworld.combo.echoed_edict.hint: What happens when an echo meets a rule?
codex.afterworld.combo.frozen_volley.des: Your own arrows hang in Stillness and resume their flight all at once when time returns.
codex.afterworld.combo.frozen_volley.hin: Loose arrows while time is thick.
codex.afterworld.combo.gravity_orbit.des: A weapon thrown into a Weightlessness rift orbits inside it, striking everything caught there, before it returns.
codex.afterworld.combo.gravity_orbit.hin: Throw a returning weapon into a place without gravity.
codex.afterworld.combo.kept_promise.desc: Hunting echoes born while a Hospitality bargain holds are bound: they never turn, and last twice as long.
codex.afterworld.combo.returning_echo.de: A weapon hurled under Echoes is followed by its own spectral double.
codex.afterworld.combo.returning_echo.hi: Throw something while your afterimage is listening.
codex.afterworld.combo.rewind_refund.des: Borrowed Time returns the Edicts you spent in the seconds it takes back.
codex.afterworld.combo.rewind_refund.hin: Borrow time right after spending it.
codex.afterworld.combo.rule_collision.de: The Arcanist’s signature: two Edicts cast as one, each stronger than alone.
codex.afterworld.combo.suspended_sentenc: Creatures held by both Weightlessness and Stillness are helpless and take half again as much damage.
Two rules about motion, at once.
codex.afterworld.creature.abyssal_angler: The light in the deep is a lure. The rest of the angler is teeth.
codex.afterworld.creature.ash_wyrmling.d: A young dragon of ash and ember. It spits fire and dives.
codex.afterworld.creature.ashen_husk.des: What the moor's old fires left standing. It still smoulders: its touch catches, and it bursts into embers when it falls. Water hurts it.
codex.afterworld.creature.ashen_husk.hin: Cross the Ashen Moor or the Ember Steppe.
Wades in the pink shallows on legs like reeds.
codex.afterworld.creature.bog_lurker.des: The fen's patient mouth. It lies still with only its eyes above the water, then lunges and drags its catch back toward the mud.
codex.afterworld.creature.bog_lurker.hin: Watch the shallows of the Gloamfen.
codex.afterworld.creature.bone_gull.desc: A gull thin enough to show its bones. It screams anyway.
codex.afterworld.creature.canyon_vulture: It waits. When you are hurt, it stops waiting.
A beetle with a forge for a belly. It bursts into embers when it dies.
codex.afterworld.creature.clockwork_sent: A Bureau construct still guarding whatever it was wound to guard. It ticks before it fires.
Cross the Ashen Moor at night.
codex.afterworld.creature.crow.desc: Crows know things. Feed one seeds and it will tell you what it has seen. Approach quietly, or it will be gone.
codex.afterworld.creature.crow.hint: Sneak up on a crow with seeds.
codex.afterworld.creature.crystal_crab.d: Grows a little garden of crystal on its shell. Wren covets them.
codex.afterworld.creature.drowned_revena: A sailor the sea gave back. It still carries its harpoon.
codex.afterworld.creature.dune_strider.d: Long-legged herd beasts of the Hourglass, striped like the caravans that follow them.
codex.afterworld.creature.dusk_hound.des: Hounds that run in packs when the light goes. When one finds you, they all do.
codex.afterworld.creature.dusk_hound.hin: Hunts the vesper downs at night.
A grey ghost of the pines. It pounces once, then decides whether you are worth a second.
codex.afterworld.creature.echo_bat.desc: Its cry is a weapon: it blinds and staggers.
codex.afterworld.creature.echo_stalker.d: Something that walks a step behind the world. It steps out of its own echo at your back, and its touch leaves you slow. Daylight thins it.
codex.afterworld.creature.ember_salamand: Cool to look at, hot to touch. Its bite carries embers.
codex.afterworld.creature.emberfox.desc: A fox whose brush never quite stops smouldering. Shy of people, fond of sweet berries.
codex.afterworld.creature.emberfox.hint: Crouch near the Ember Steppe's grass.
codex.afterworld.creature.fen_toad.desc: Its tongue reaches further than you think. Mab brews its oil.
codex.afterworld.creature.fen_toad.hint: Croaks in the black water of the fen.
codex.afterworld.creature.floe_seal.desc: Barks at boats, sleeps on ice, ignores everything else.
codex.afterworld.creature.fungal_brute.d: A mushroom grown too big and too angry, breathing dizzying spores.
codex.afterworld.creature.gearhound.desc: A Bureau tracking-engine shaped like a hound. They hunt in packs, by day as well as night; hurt one and the pack turns on you.
codex.afterworld.creature.gearhound.hint: Cross the canyons and the dunes.
codex.afterworld.creature.glimmerfin.des: Little fish with a lit stripe down each side. Their schools turn rivers into slow stars. They fit in a bucket.
codex.afterworld.creature.glimmerfin.hin: Look into the Silverrun at night.
codex.afterworld.creature.gloomweaver.de: A spider the size of a cart, spinning in the gloom. Its webs slow you; its bite poisons.
codex.afterworld.creature.glyph_scarab.d: Gold-backed beetles that guard the old glyphs in swarms.
codex.afterworld.creature.highland_ram.d: Its horns have settled a thousand arguments. Do not be the thousand-and-first.
codex.afterworld.creature.hollow_stag.de: A stag with antlers like moonlit glass. It bolts from anyone who walks; it lets the patient come close.
codex.afterworld.creature.ice_crawler.de: Many-legged and crystal-backed. It climbs walls and its bite freezes.
codex.afterworld.creature.kitsune.desc: A fox of three tails that walks between one place and the next. It throws foxfire when cornered.
codex.afterworld.creature.lantern_moth.d: A night moth with a lantern for an abdomen. It drifts toward any light it can find, and leaves glowing dust when it dies.
Mud and roots in the shape of a man, breathing spores.
Rises from the fen at night.
codex.afterworld.creature.mirror_ray.des: A great flat ray whose back holds the sky like a mirror. Now and then it leaps clear of the sea.
codex.afterworld.creature.mossback.desc: A patient beast with a garden on its shell. Shear the moss and it grows back, given time and green ground.
codex.afterworld.creature.mossmere_owl.d: Moss grows on its feathers. It watches everything, says little.
codex.afterworld.creature.mourning_shade: A grief that never ended. It drifts, weeps cold, and blinks from place to place.
codex.afterworld.creature.petal_sprite.d: A spark of the blossom groves no bigger than a hand, with petals for wings. They chime to each other as they drift.
codex.afterworld.creature.prism_golem.de: Living crystal in a golem's shape. Arrows and spells glance off it and fly back.
codex.afterworld.creature.rime_brute.des: Kin of the Rimeback Colossus, smaller only by comparison. It throws ice like stones.
codex.afterworld.creature.rime_moth.desc: Its wings are frost. Rime silk comes from its cocoons.
codex.afterworld.creature.rime_wight.des: A spirit of the white wastes, crowned in icicles. It keeps its distance and breathes a line of frost that freezes.
codex.afterworld.creature.rimehorn.desc: The shaggy, ice-horned herd beast of the Whitewaste. Milk it, or shear it for a thick white fleece that grows back.
codex.afterworld.creature.rimehorn.hint: Follow the herds across the snow.
codex.afterworld.creature.rootling_senti: Old wood that stands up when you trespass, and drags you down when you run.
Guards the rootways and hollow woods.
codex.afterworld.creature.rule_wraith.de: It feeds on rules. Its touch steals one of your equipped Edicts for a while. Dawn burns it away.
A small cousin of the clockwork sentries, slow and patient, with fists like anvils.
codex.afterworld.creature.sand_sifter.de: It waits beneath the sand. You will not see it until it decides you are close enough.
codex.afterworld.creature.sand_sifter.hi: Hides under the dunes and canyons.
codex.afterworld.creature.shardling.desc: A crawling cluster of living crystal. It leaps, and when it breaks it breaks into smaller ones that keep coming.
codex.afterworld.creature.shardling.hint: Walk the Shardfields after dark, or the spires.
codex.afterworld.creature.silverrun_otte: Plays in the river, steals your fish, regrets nothing.
codex.afterworld.creature.skywhale.desc: Whales that swim the sky, glowing faintly along the belly. They sing to each other across the valleys. Nothing can hurt them.
codex.afterworld.creature.snow_hare.desc: White as the drifts it hides in, until it moves.
codex.afterworld.creature.sporeling.desc: A walking mushroom, shy and glowing. It hops when happy.
codex.afterworld.creature.thornback_boar: Brambles grow along its spine. Leave it be and it leaves you be; strike it and it charges.
codex.afterworld.creature.tidecaller_jel: A drifting lantern of the warm seas. Do not touch.
codex.afterworld.creature.tusked_narwhal: Unicorn of the cold seas. It charges anything that threatens its pod.
codex.afterworld.creature.vine_strangler: A plant that has learned to want. Its vines pull; its bulb bites.
codex.afterworld.creature.windrider_eagl: The great eagle of the peaks, with feathers prized by every fletcher.
codex.afterworld.creature.wisp.desc: A fen light. Some only flee. Some lead you to something left behind, if you follow.
codex.afterworld.creature.wisp.hint: Follow a light in the Gloamfen.
codex.afterworld.discipline.arcanist.des: Edict combinations and tactical control. Carries more rules, and turns them faster. Signature, Rule Collision: Cast the Edicts in your first two slots at once, both at greater strength. Passive: A fourth Edict slot, and Edict cooldowns 25% shorter.
codex.afterworld.discipline.arcanist.hin: Choose a Discipline in the Expedition Journal.
codex.afterworld.discipline.keeper.desc: Contracts, summons and bargains. Makes friends of things that should not have friends. Signature, Unpaid Favour: Summon two spectral hounds for thirty seconds. Afterwards you owe the Favour six hostile kills within ten minutes, or it takes experience as interest. Passive: Echoes and pacts last 50% longer, and bonds allow a day of grace.
codex.afterworld.discipline.keeper.favou: Favours are repaid in hostile kills, or the debt collects experience as interest.
codex.afterworld.discipline.keeper.hint: Choose a Discipline in the Expedition Journal.
Spectral wolves answer a Keeper's call. They bite for their Keeper's sake and mend them with each wound.
codex.afterworld.discipline.vanguard.des: Close-range control, defence and posture. Built to hold a line and punish mistakes. Signature, Last Word: Only near defeat (below 40% health): a shockwave that hits harder the more you have lost, followed by a moment of resistance. Passive: +2 hearts. Raising a shield just before a blow lands staggers the attacker.
codex.afterworld.discipline.vanguard.hin: Choose a Discipline in the Expedition Journal.
codex.afterworld.discipline.vanguard.las: Near defeat, a Vanguard’s counter hits hardest.
codex.afterworld.discipline.vanguard.par: Raise a shield a heartbeat before a blow lands and the attacker staggers, slowed and weakened.
Timing matters more than the shield.
codex.afterworld.discipline.vanguard.unb: The Vanguard leaps, lands like a falling wall, and stands there daring the world to try again.
codex.afterworld.discipline.wayfarer.des: Mobility, precision and exploration. Quick on the road and hard to pin down. Signature, Wrong Turn: Press once to mark where you stand. Press again within thirty seconds to return to the mark. Passive: +10% speed and four extra blocks of safe falling.
codex.afterworld.discipline.wayfarer.hin: Choose a Discipline in the Expedition Journal.
codex.afterworld.discipline.wayfarer.wro: Mark a place, then return to it from up to a hundred and twenty-eight blocks away.
codex.afterworld.edict.borrowed_time.des: You may return to a recent version of yourself. Step back to where you were about five seconds ago, with the health, hunger and burns you had then. Edicts you spent in those seconds come back to you. Limit: A short window, within one dimension. Items, the world and other people do not rewind.
codex.afterworld.edict.borrowed_time.hin: The King of Seconds keeps it close to his chest.
codex.afterworld.edict.echoes.desc: A recent action repeats as a spectral afterimage. For six seconds, every strike you land is repeated a second later by your afterimage at half strength. The next Edict you cast in that window is echoed too. Limit: Echoes are weaker and delayed; a target that moves may not be there for them.
codex.afterworld.edict.echoes.hint: There are places where every sound happens twice.
codex.afterworld.edict.forgotten.desc: Creatures forget you exist. Every creature within sixteen blocks loses track of you and cannot target you for eight seconds. Limit: Ends the moment you strike.
codex.afterworld.edict.forgotten.hint: Places people visit and cannot remember why.
codex.afterworld.edict.hospitality.desc: An honoured bargain forbids hostility. Offer a bargain to the creature you look at, or to every hostile creature close by. For forty-five seconds they will not treat you as a threat. Limit: Terms: you may not strike anything while it holds. Break it and they are enraged, and you are marked Oathbreaker.
codex.afterworld.edict.hospitality.hint: A table is set for guests who never quite arrive.
codex.afterworld.edict.hunger.desc: Defeated foes leave a hunting echo. For twenty seconds, foes you defeat rise again as translucent echoes that hunt for you, up to three at a time. Limit: Echoes fade quickly, and an unbound echo may turn on the nearest gentle creature instead.
codex.afterworld.edict.hunger.hint: Barrows where the bones are always fresh.
codex.afterworld.edict.return.desc: A marked object returns to its owner. Hurl your held weapon. It pierces up to four foes and flies back to the slot it left. With nothing to throw, it recalls your dropped items and fired arrows instead. Limit: Weapons and tools only. Blocked by walls; while in flight, the weapon is not in your hand.
codex.afterworld.edict.return.hint: Somewhere, whatever you throw comes back to you.
codex.afterworld.edict.stillness.desc: Time thickens around you. For four seconds, projectiles near you hang in the air and creatures move as if through syrup. Your own arrows keep their speed for when time resumes. Limit: Short and bounded. Things that were thrown at you simply fall.
codex.afterworld.edict.stillness.hint: A stream that stopped moving last spring, and is still wet.
codex.afterworld.edict.trespass.desc: A wall is only a suggestion. Step through up to five blocks of solid wall in the direction you face, if there is room on the other side. Limit: Warded stone, bedrock and machinery cannot be crossed.
codex.afterworld.edict.trespass.hint: The Pilgrim walks where there are no roads.
codex.afterworld.edict.weightlessness.de: Gravity forgets a small place for a while. Open a gravity rift where you look. Creatures inside drift helplessly upward, arrows fly straight and you fall softly. When it closes, everything comes down. Limit: Bounded radius and duration. Heavy creatures resist being lifted.
codex.afterworld.edict.weightlessness.hi: Fields where stones float as if they forgot which way is down.
codex.afterworld.edict.witness.desc: Nothing near you may go unseen. Every creature within thirty-two blocks glows, chests and spawners pulse with light, and your nearest lead flares in its direction. Limit: A glimpse, not a map: ten seconds of sight.
codex.afterworld.edict.witness.hint: Clearings where you feel watched by something taking notes.
codex.afterworld.event.silent_caravan.de: Unsafe roads stop caravans. Defend one, and the settlement it was bound for recovers.
codex.afterworld.npc.archivist.desc: An echo who keeps the Unremembered village’s census, and forgets a page of it every night.
codex.afterworld.npc.archivist.hint: Visit the village that appears in thunder.
codex.afterworld.npc.landlord.desc: A ghost landlord with a strong sense of duty and a weak grasp of how long ago he died.
codex.afterworld.npc.landlord.hint: He owns property in the Unremembered village.
codex.afterworld.npc.roadwright.desc: Merchant of the Road That Moves, which links places that should not connect. Trades rare rules for rare materials.
codex.afterworld.npc.roadwright.hint: The road stops near places that have been found.
codex.afterworld.origin.bureau_clerk.des: You filed anomalies for the Bureau of Impossible Things until one of them filed you. Bureau agents trust your paperwork.
codex.afterworld.origin.court_mourner.de: The Morrow Court taught you the names of the departed. Its keepers welcome you, and the forgotten sometimes do too.
codex.afterworld.origin.crown_squire.des: You carried a banner for the Crown until the road carried you off. Crown folk still greet you as one of their own.
codex.afterworld.origin.guild_cartograph: The Cartographers' Guild taught you to measure the world, and the world refuses to hold still. Guildsfolk trade with you on better terms.
codex.afterworld.origin.wanderer.desc: Nobody in particular. Every faction treats you as a curiosity rather than a rival, and you came well supplied.
codex.afterworld.people.akane.desc: The last disciple of the Lantern Dojo. Her master became the Ashen Shogun; she keeps his hundred lanterns, and his challenge.
codex.afterworld.people.akane.hint: Someone keeps the lanterns lit in the blossom country.
codex.afterworld.people.bram.desc: Feeds, lights and stitches the camp together, and buys the strange parts beasts leave behind.
codex.afterworld.people.ines.desc: Of the Morrow Court. Tends the drowned chapel, and the wounds of those who pass it.
codex.afterworld.people.isolde.desc: Keeps the Waystone Camp, and the travellers who wake there. She hears the waystones hum.
codex.afterworld.people.leyla.desc: Rashid's elder sister, master of the caravan that went silent. Hid eight drivers under the Buried Obelisk, and counted the spice.
codex.afterworld.people.leyla.hint: Someone is hiding in the dunes.
codex.afterworld.people.mab.desc: The witch of the black water. Brews before fights, never after.
codex.afterworld.people.marta.desc: Smith to the Wardens. Brings beasts’ parts and emeralds to her forge, and she makes weapons of them.
codex.afterworld.people.odo.desc: Master of the Wayfarer, the only airship in the sky, moored for repairs.
codex.afterworld.people.rashid.desc: Master of the caravan at the Hourglass Oasis, where the water is free.
codex.afterworld.people.selene.desc: Keeps the Moon Gazebo and counts the stars that fall. One fewer, every night.
codex.afterworld.people.torvald.desc: Hunts what hunts the valley, and warns of something tall in the frozen peaks.
codex.afterworld.people.wren.desc: A Guild cartographer who maps the places that won't sit still. She will mark places on your map.
codex.afterworld.pilgrim.shrine_repaired: You mended a pilgrim shrine. If all four are whole, the Pilgrim can finish its walk.
Bring an offering to a cracked shrine.
codex.afterworld.place.anomaly.desc: Places where one of the world’s rules has come loose. Break the core to seal it and keep its Edict, or tap it with a glass bottle for residue. Tapped anomalies grow.
codex.afterworld.place.anomaly.hint: Rumours speak of places where the rules run thin.
codex.afterworld.place.cache.desc: Hidden stores, often mentioned in rumours. Not every rumour about them is true.
codex.afterworld.place.cache.hint: Somebody always knows somebody who buried something.
codex.afterworld.place.cathedral.desc: Home of the Bell-Ringer, whose bell silences Edicts.
codex.afterworld.place.lair.desc: A Marked Beast that troubles a settlement. Killing it restores the village’s safety.
codex.afterworld.place.lair.hint: Villages that feel unsafe know where the tracks lead.
codex.afterworld.place.settlement.desc: Villages remember. Each tracks its safety, prosperity, legitimacy and strangeness, which change with what happens there. Sneak and right-click a villager with an empty hand to ask what they have heard.
codex.afterworld.place.shrine.desc: Old shrines along the Pilgrim’s road. A Pilgrim Offering mends one, and the Pilgrim remembers who mended them.
codex.afterworld.place.unremembered.desc: A village that appears on stormy nights. Its people forget a part of their lives every night.
codex.afterworld.place.unremembered.hint: A merchant swears it appears in thunder.
codex.afterworld.place.vault.desc: An adaptive dungeon beneath a clocktower. It studies how it is fought and changes its wardens to match.
codex.afterworld.quest.unremembered: The Village That Appears at Night
codex.afterworld.quest.unremembered.desc: Restore the missing history, sell it, or let the village begin anew. Each choice changes what grows there.
The blade apologises, at length, whenever it is turned on something that meant no harm.
After a perfect parry, the blade answers with a counterattack of its own.
Granted by the Crown, or forged with a bell fragment.
codex.afterworld.relic.clockwork_heart.d: Winds itself when you are hurt. Release a charge to open a bubble of slowed time around you.
codex.afterworld.relic.clockwork_heart.h: Granted by the Bureau, or made with clockwork.
codex.afterworld.relic.clockwork_heart.o: Released twice in quick succession, the Clockwork Heart overheats and burns you.
codex.afterworld.relic.hungry_lantern.de: While lit in your hand it reveals invisible creatures and traces of your leads, and eats your experience. Keep it lit long enough and something may move in.
codex.afterworld.relic.hungry_lantern.hi: Granted by the Court, or made with moth dust.
codex.afterworld.relic.thimble.desc: A tiny rainstorm that waters crops, puts out fires and uncovers tracks toward your leads. Things that follow rain may follow it.
codex.afterworld.relic.thimble.hint: Granted by the Bureau, or made with residue.
codex.afterworld.relic.unfinished_compas: Points toward your tracked rumour, or the nearest one. Far away, it points at a clue on the way rather than the destination.
Granted by the Guild, or made from residue and a compass.
codex.afterworld.rule.oathbreaker.desc: Break a Hospitality bargain and the creatures you deceived are enraged, while you are weakened and cannot bargain for five minutes.
codex.afterworld.rumour.false.desc: You followed a false rumour, and found out who wanted it told.
codex.afterworld.rumour.first.desc: Rumours come from real things in the world. They tell you which way and how far, never exactly where. Some leave things out, some are out of date, and some are lies.
codex.afterworld.rumour.first.hint: Ask a villager what they have heard.
codex.afterworld.rumour.outdated.desc: Someone settled a rumour before you could. The Chronicle remembers who.
codex.afterworld.vault.adapt.anchored.de: You leaned on Weightlessness, so the Vault chained its wardens down. Other rules still apply.
codex.afterworld.vault.adapt.anchored.hi: Lift the Vault’s wardens too often.
codex.afterworld.vault.adapt.expected.de: The Vault remembered which wing you took first, and sent more wardens there.
codex.afterworld.vault.adapt.expected.hi: Return to the Vault by the same route.
codex.afterworld.vault.adapt.listening.d: You crept through the Vault, so it hung bells that ring when you pass. Move quickly, or break them.
codex.afterworld.vault.adapt.mirrored.de: You favoured the bow, so the Vault armed its wardens with mirrored shields that turn arrows aside. Close the distance.
codex.afterworld.vault.adapt.mirrored.hi: Fight the Vault from a distance.
codex.afterworld.vault.adapt.spiked.desc: You favoured the blade, so the Vault covered its wardens in spikes that punish every strike. Keep your distance.
codex.afterworld.vault.adapt.warded.desc: You walked through the Vault’s walls, so it warded them. Look for the door it forgot.
codex.afterworld.vault.entered.desc: The Vault of Seconds counts how you fight: blades or bows, which Edicts, how quietly. Return, and it will have changed to meet you.
codex.afterworld.wonder.abandoned_mine.d: A timbered mine in the Rustscar Canyons, its tracks running down into the dark. The golemites moved in.
codex.afterworld.wonder.abandoned_mine.h: Timbers at the foot of a canyon wall.
codex.afterworld.wonder.airship.desc: An airship of the Cartographers' Guild at its mooring mast. Captain Odo will take you aboard, for a fare.
codex.afterworld.wonder.airship.hint: Look up: a ship moored to a mast.
codex.afterworld.wonder.angels.desc: Two winged guardians of white stone face each other across a ruined way. Their haloes still glow at night, though nothing passes.
codex.afterworld.wonder.angels.hint: Two figures keep watch over a road to nowhere.
codex.afterworld.wonder.aurora_shrine.de: A small shrine of ice and sea-lanterns in the Glimmerfrost. Three candles wait to be lit.
codex.afterworld.wonder.barrow_mound.des: A burial mound on the Vesper Downs. In its deepest chamber the Crimson Lich hid a piece of his life.
codex.afterworld.wonder.barrow_mound.hin: A grassy mound with a stone door.
codex.afterworld.wonder.beached_wreck.de: A ship lying on her side in the shallows, ribs to the sky, her mast across the sand.
codex.afterworld.wonder.bone_orchard.des: A walled garden of graves and bone-white trees around a ruined chapel. The mourners walk it at night.
codex.afterworld.wonder.buried_obelisk.d: A gilded obelisk half-swallowed by the sand, with a hall beneath it. The caravan hid there from the storm-eaters, and a Glyph Tablet waits deeper still.
codex.afterworld.wonder.buried_obelisk.h: An obelisk rising from the dunes.
codex.afterworld.wonder.canopy_outpost.d: Huts in the crowns of two jungle giants, joined by a hanging bridge.
codex.afterworld.wonder.canopy_outpost.h: Huts high in the jungle trees.
codex.afterworld.wonder.canyon_outpost.d: A stilted lookout and a rope bridge between two canyon pillars, built by prospectors who never came back for it.
codex.afterworld.wonder.caravan_wreck.de: Two wagons of Rashid's sister's caravan, broken on the old road. The wheels were cut, the cargo left behind, and the tracks lead into the dunes.
codex.afterworld.wonder.caravan_wreck.hi: Something went wrong on the old caravan road.
codex.afterworld.wonder.cathedral.desc: A walled city around a great cathedral of glass and spires. Its windows burn every night for a congregation no one has seen arrive.
codex.afterworld.wonder.cathedral.hint: Look for spires above the plains at dusk.
codex.afterworld.wonder.chapel.desc: A small stone chapel by the road. The Morrow Court keeps its candles burning for travellers who never came home.
codex.afterworld.wonder.chapel.hint: A small chapel by the road.
codex.afterworld.wonder.cinder_watchtowe: A broken black tower on the moor, taken over by a cult of the ash. Their leader keeps the tower's top.
A black tower with a camp at its foot.
codex.afterworld.wonder.citadel.desc: A fortress of needle spires on a sheer crag, its windows lit by soul fire. The Bureau files it under things that were here first.
codex.afterworld.wonder.citadel.hint: Violet lights high on a crag, in the dark lands.
A spire of bare rock with footholds spiralling up its sides. Whoever reaches the top keeps what is waiting there.
A rock spire with a red flag on top.
codex.afterworld.wonder.colossus_graveya: Ribs like arches and a skull like a house, half-buried in the Whitewaste. Fresh tracks lead away from the bones.
codex.afterworld.wonder.crimson_necropol: A walled city of red stone in the pale lands. The Crimson Lich waits on his throne at its heart, and one of its mausoleums keeps his last phylactery.
Red walls in the pale lands.
codex.afterworld.wonder.crystal_observat: A domed observatory in the Shardfields. Its lenses wake in order, from the faintest crystal to the brightest.
codex.afterworld.wonder.drowned_catacomb: Beneath a mausoleum of pale stone lie the catacombs: corridors of burial niches, an ossuary chapel of bone, a wing the groundwater has taken, and the Crypt Lord's tomb behind bars that answer four cold candles.
A pale mausoleum with its door standing open.
codex.afterworld.wonder.drowned_shrine.d: A shrine of the Morrow Court half taken by the sea, its bell tower empty. The bell-ringer's apprentice kept the rope here.
codex.afterworld.wonder.drowned_shrine.h: A shrine with its feet in the sea.
codex.afterworld.wonder.druids_ring.desc: Standing stones around a flat altar in Mossmere Wood. Strike them as their flames count, and the altar gives up its gift.
codex.afterworld.wonder.ember_kilns.desc: The kilns where the Ashen Moor once fired its glass. Light all four at once and the foreman's vault opens.
codex.afterworld.wonder.frozen_mage_towe: A mage's tower in the Rimeglass Spires, frozen from the cellar up. Warm its three hearths and the case at the top will thaw.
A tower of ice among the spires.
codex.afterworld.wonder.frozen_watch_pos: A spruce lookout tower in the Frostmere Pines. Whoever kept watch left in a hurry, and left their lockbox.
A lookout tower in the pines.
codex.afterworld.wonder.geode_vault.desc: A sinkhole lined with crystal opens into a geode as wide as a hall. A spiral of quartz hangs in its middle, down to a platform where four pylons guard a crystal case.
codex.afterworld.wonder.geode_vault.hint: A sinkhole ringed with crystal, and a surveyor's winch at its lip.
codex.afterworld.wonder.gilded_vault.des: A vault cut into a highland cliff behind a gate of gold. Set the five Glyph Tablets into the gate and the Gilded Warden wakes to judge you.
codex.afterworld.wonder.gilded_vault.hin: A golden gate in a highland cliff.
codex.afterworld.wonder.glowcap_grotto.d: A grotto lit by glowing mushrooms around a still spring.
codex.afterworld.wonder.glowcap_grotto.h: A glowing cave mouth in the spores.
codex.afterworld.wonder.glowcap_hollow.d: A hollow stump in the deep wood hides a ramp down through the roots into a cavern of giant glowing mushrooms, where a hermit lived beside a pool and the Mycelium Heart keeps a hoard in a cage of stems.
codex.afterworld.wonder.glowcap_hollow.h: A great hollow stump that breathes spores at dusk.
codex.afterworld.wonder.great_nest.desc: A nest of whole trees on a pillar of rock, high above the peaks. The windriders do not share.
codex.afterworld.wonder.great_nest.hint: A nest on a rock pillar.
Dead trees hung with soul lanterns over five cold candles. Light them, and the grove gives back what it keeps.
codex.afterworld.wonder.hermits_bough.de: A treehouse high in a Hollowwood giant, with a hermit's diary and a hermit's hoard.
codex.afterworld.wonder.hermits_bough.hi: A house in a giant tree.
codex.afterworld.wonder.icyshroom.desc: A giant mushroom of blue ice, hollowed into a shelter by someone who liked the cold more than company.
codex.afterworld.wonder.icyshroom.hint: Look for a blue cap among the snows.
codex.afterworld.wonder.ladder_gate.desc: A broken arch of dark stone over a lit gate-stone: the way into the Warden's Ladder, fifty floors of waves and echoes where the old Edict-writers proved their Wardens.
codex.afterworld.wonder.ladder_gate.hint: A dark arch over a glowing stone.
codex.afterworld.wonder.ladder_gate_firs: A broken arch of dark stone over a lit gate-stone: the way into the Warden's Ladder, fifty floors of waves and echoes where the old Edict-writers proved their Wardens.
A dark arch over a glowing stone.
codex.afterworld.wonder.lantern_dojo.des: The house of the Ashen Shogun, where his last disciple Akane still keeps the hundred lanterns.
codex.afterworld.wonder.lantern_dojo.hin: A great hall of lanterns in the blossom country.
codex.afterworld.wonder.lighthouse.desc: A red-and-white lighthouse on the shore rocks, its lamp long cold, and the keeper's empty cottage.
codex.afterworld.wonder.lighthouse.hint: A striped tower on the shore.
codex.afterworld.wonder.lodge.desc: A log cabin on a cobbled footing, with trophies on the walls. Torvald keeps it, and the forest around it.
codex.afterworld.wonder.lodge.hint: Follow chimney smoke in the woods.
codex.afterworld.wonder.mill.desc: The Cartographers' Guild mill and skyport: a great waterwheel, copper pipes, smoking chimneys and an airship moored at the tower.
codex.afterworld.wonder.mill.hint: Follow the smoke and the sound of the wheel.
codex.afterworld.wonder.moon_gazebo.desc: A white gazebo open to the sky, where Selene keeps count of the falling stars.
codex.afterworld.wonder.moon_gazebo.hint: A pale dome on a hill, lit at night.
codex.afterworld.wonder.moonlit_clearing: A fairy ring in the Duskpine Weald, with cold candles on its stones and something buried beneath its altar.
A ring of mushrooms and stones in the weald.
codex.afterworld.wonder.nomad_yurts.desc: Round felt tents of the steppe nomads, with a horse pen and a cooking fire. The nomads are out riding.
codex.afterworld.wonder.oasis.desc: Palms around a spring in the dunes, where Rashid's caravan waters its camels and sells everything else.
codex.afterworld.wonder.ossuary_gate.des: A gate of bone set into the Pale Reach, opening onto an ossuary. The Lich's second phylactery is kept within.
codex.afterworld.wonder.ossuary_gate.hin: A white gate in the Pale Reach.
codex.afterworld.wonder.overgrown_ziggur: A stepped pyramid swallowed by the Verdant Tangle. Light the four braziers on its summit and its heart opens.
codex.afterworld.wonder.peak_monastery.d: A monastery on the Skyspire Peaks, its shrine reached only by stepping stones across the drop.
codex.afterworld.wonder.proving_ring.des: A ring of standing stones round a trodden arena. Strike the horn-stone at its heart and the land sends three waves of its creatures; hold the ring and the barred cist at its edge opens.
codex.afterworld.wonder.proving_ring.hin: Standing stones round a trodden ring.
codex.afterworld.wonder.ranger_outpost.d: A palisade camp of the weald rangers, with a watch platform and an archery range.
codex.afterworld.wonder.ranger_outpost.h: A palisade among the dusk pines.
codex.afterworld.wonder.rime_cavern.desc: A cave of blue ice in the Rimeglass Spires, where rime pearls grow in the dark and something big sleeps.
codex.afterworld.wonder.rime_cavern.hint: A blue cave among the spires.
codex.afterworld.wonder.rimeback_den.des: A hollow in the ice of the Whitewaste, half open to the sky and strewn with bones. The Rimeback Colossus sleeps here, when it sleeps.
codex.afterworld.wonder.rimeback_den.hin: A great hollow in the ice.
codex.afterworld.wonder.shattered_carava: A Guild wagon broken open by crystals that grew in a single night. The shardlings guard what fell out.
codex.afterworld.wonder.snowbound_camp.d: Three tents, a sled and a cold fire in the Whitewaste. The traders' last entry is still in the ledger.
codex.afterworld.wonder.spore_lab.desc: A giant mushroom hollowed into a laboratory, its alchemist long gone. Her notes are still on the bench.
codex.afterworld.wonder.star_spire.desc: A needle of dark stone crowned with a crystal that drinks in starlight and gives it back at dusk.
codex.afterworld.wonder.star_spire.hint: A dark needle that glows at dusk.
A crater in the Ember Steppe around a fallen star that has not finished glowing. Star Fragments litter the slope.
codex.afterworld.wonder.stilt_house.desc: A crooked house on stilts above the fen, where Fen-Keeper Mab brews things that are mostly legal.
codex.afterworld.wonder.stilt_house.hint: A crooked house above the black water.
codex.afterworld.wonder.sun_temple.desc: A sandstone temple round a sun-dial court. Four mirrors stand in the court; struck in the right order, their light wakes the Dune Sentinel in the sanctum.
codex.afterworld.wonder.sun_temple.hint: A temple with a sun-dial court, in the dunes.
codex.afterworld.wonder.sunken_bog_templ: A temple of the old Wardens, sinking into the Gloamfen. Four braziers ring its sanctum, and behind the seal lies a Glyph Tablet.
Pillars standing in the black water.
codex.afterworld.wonder.sunken_forge.des: Under a ruined forge-house, a shaft winds thirty blocks down to the old smiths' hall: a channel of lava, the great forge at its end, and a vault whose bars lift only when all four of the forge's fires burn.
codex.afterworld.wonder.sunken_forge.hin: A forge-house chimney standing alone, and warm air rising from the ground.
codex.afterworld.wonder.tea_house.desc: A tea house of cherry wood and paper screens beside a koi pond. Its master left a poem, and the kettle.
codex.afterworld.wonder.titan.desc: A horned colossus chained to four obelisks, kneeling over a sword it has not drawn in an age. Whatever it was, the world decided it should not stand.
codex.afterworld.wonder.titan.hint: Something vast kneels where the ash lies thickest.
codex.afterworld.wonder.waystone.desc: A carved pillar with a turning crystal. Attune to it, and the Wardens' roads will carry you back.
codex.afterworld.wonder.waystone.hint: Pillars with turning crystals, all over the world.
codex.afterworld.wonder.weavers_hollow.d: A cave mouth in the Gloomwald choked with webs and cocoons. Something large spins in the dark.
codex.afterworld.wonder.weavers_hollow.h: A cave hung with white threads.
codex.afterworld.wonder.wind_harp.desc: Five posts of a giant's harp on the Windworn Highlands. Strike them in the right order and the cairn opens.
codex.afterworld.wonder.wind_harp.hint: Stone posts singing in the wind.
consumable.afterworld.ember_oil: Hold in your off hand and use: your weapon burns what it strikes for 60 hits.
consumable.afterworld.frost_bomb: Throw: freezes everything it bursts on.
consumable.afterworld.frost_oil: Hold in your off hand and use: your weapon chills and slows for 60 hits.
consumable.afterworld.lockpick: Opens locked chests in ruins and crypts (a small trial).
consumable.afterworld.resonance_draught: Half a charge of Resonance for your Aspect.
consumable.afterworld.smoke_bomb: Throw: blinds foes, makes them lose you, and hides you for five seconds.
consumable.afterworld.stamina_elixir: Fills your stamina and enlarges it by half for three minutes.
consumable.afterworld.survey_scroll: Read it to mark the nearest landmark on your map.
consumable.afterworld.thunder_bomb: Throw: a lightning strike that stuns.
consumable.afterworld.venom_oil: Hold in your off hand and use: your weapon poisons for 60 hits.
consumable.afterworld.waystone_shard: Crush it to return to the Wayfarers' camp.
dialogue.afterworld.hint: Space: continue · A: auto (%s) · L: log · Esc: leave
discipline.afterworld.arcanist.passive: Passive: A fourth Edict slot, and Edict cooldowns 25% shorter.
discipline.afterworld.arcanist.signature: Fuse your first two Edicts into one cast at double power, with a fusion of their kinds (Overload, Bulwark, Comet, Accord or Revelation). Half of both cooldowns comes straight back.
discipline.afterworld.arcanist.style: Edict combinations and tactical control. Carries more rules, and turns them faster.
discipline.afterworld.keeper.passive: Passive: Echoes and pacts last 50% longer, and bonds allow a day of grace.
discipline.afterworld.keeper.signature.d: Three spectral wolves run with you for thirty seconds. They draw foes onto themselves, and every bite mends you. Your summons last half again as long.
discipline.afterworld.keeper.style: Contracts, summons and bargains. Makes friends of things that should not have friends.
discipline.afterworld.vanguard.passive: Passive: +2 hearts. Raising a shield just before a blow lands staggers the attacker.
discipline.afterworld.vanguard.signature: Leap and slam the ground: everything near is thrown into the air and staggered (more with Renown). For five seconds after, you take half damage and every foe nearby wants only you. Last Word is now passive: once every three minutes, a killing blow leaves you standing.
discipline.afterworld.vanguard.style: Close-range control, defence and posture. Built to hold a line and punish mistakes.
discipline.afterworld.wayfarer.passive: Passive: +10% speed and four extra blocks of safe falling.
discipline.afterworld.wayfarer.signature: Blink from foe to foe (up to five within twelve blocks), striking each for 160%% of your weapon, then step back to where you began. Hold the key instead for Wrong Turn: mark this spot, and hold again within thirty seconds to return to it.
discipline.afterworld.wayfarer.style: Mobility, precision and exploration. Quick on the road and hard to pin down.
edict.afterworld.borrowed_time.capstone: Rank III: the moment you leave explodes a second later, and every cooldown comes back.
edict.afterworld.borrowed_time.desc: Step back to where you were about five seconds ago, with the health, hunger and burns you had then. Edicts you spent in those seconds come back to you.
edict.afterworld.borrowed_time.hint: The King of Seconds keeps it close to his chest.
edict.afterworld.borrowed_time.limit: A short window, within one dimension. Items, the world and other people do not rewind.
edict.afterworld.borrowed_time.rule: You may return to a recent version of yourself.
edict.afterworld.echoes.capstone: Rank III: the afterimage stays ten seconds, strikes at 75% and repeats your next two Edicts.
edict.afterworld.echoes.desc: For six seconds, every strike you land is repeated a second later by your afterimage at half strength. The next Edict you cast in that window is echoed too.
edict.afterworld.echoes.hint: There are places where every sound happens twice.
edict.afterworld.echoes.limit: Echoes are weaker and delayed; a target that moves may not be there for them.
edict.afterworld.echoes.rule: A recent action repeats as a spectral afterimage.
edict.afterworld.forgotten.capstone: Rank III: your first strike from hiding deals triple damage and keeps you hidden a second longer.
edict.afterworld.forgotten.desc: Every creature within sixteen blocks loses track of you and cannot target you for eight seconds.
edict.afterworld.forgotten.hint: Places people visit and cannot remember why.
edict.afterworld.fusion.bulwark: Bulwark: you stand behind the rule.
edict.afterworld.fusion.comet: Comet: you move like a rule unbound.
edict.afterworld.fusion.revelation: Revelation: every foe is shown to you.
edict.afterworld.hospitality.capstone: Rank III: your guests fight for you for twenty seconds. Only striking a guest breaks faith.
edict.afterworld.hospitality.desc: Offer a bargain to the creature you look at, or to every hostile creature close by. For forty-five seconds they will not treat you as a threat.
edict.afterworld.hospitality.hint: A table is set for guests who never quite arrive.
edict.afterworld.hospitality.limit: Terms: you may not strike anything while it holds. Break it and they are enraged, and you are marked Oathbreaker.
edict.afterworld.hunger.capstone: Rank III: up to five echoes. They strike at half your strength and burst when they fade.
edict.afterworld.hunger.desc: For twenty seconds, foes you defeat rise again as translucent echoes that hunt for you, up to three at a time.
edict.afterworld.hunger.hint: Barrows where the bones are always fresh.
edict.afterworld.hunger.limit: Echoes fade quickly, and an unbound echo may turn on the nearest gentle creature instead.
edict.afterworld.hunger.rule: Defeated foes leave a hunting echo.
edict.afterworld.return.capstone: Rank III: it leaps between up to six foes, then lands home with a shockwave.
edict.afterworld.return.desc: Hurl your held weapon. It pierces up to four foes and flies back to the slot it left. With nothing to throw, it recalls your dropped items and fired arrows instead.
edict.afterworld.return.hint: Somewhere, whatever you throw comes back to you.
edict.afterworld.return.limit: Weapons and tools only. Blocked by walls; while in flight, the weapon is not in your hand.
edict.afterworld.return.rule: A marked object returns to its owner.
edict.afterworld.stillness.capstone: Rank III: creatures freeze for three seconds. What you deal them lands at the end, half again as hard.
edict.afterworld.stillness.desc: For four seconds, projectiles near you hang in the air and creatures move as if through syrup. Your own arrows keep their speed for when time resumes.
edict.afterworld.stillness.hint: A stream that stopped moving last spring, and is still wet.
edict.afterworld.stillness.limit: Short and bounded. Things that were thrown at you simply fall.
edict.afterworld.trespass.capstone: Rank III: step through floors, ceilings and open air, leaving a rift that cuts whatever follows.
edict.afterworld.trespass.desc: Step through up to five blocks of solid wall in the direction you face, if there is room on the other side.
edict.afterworld.trespass.hint: The Pilgrim walks where there are no roads.
edict.afterworld.trespass.limit: Warded stone, bedrock and machinery cannot be crossed.
edict.afterworld.trespass.rule: A wall is only a suggestion.
edict.afterworld.weightlessness.capstone: Rank III: the rift drags foes into its eye, then slams them down for double fall damage.
edict.afterworld.weightlessness.desc: Open a gravity rift where you look. Creatures inside drift helplessly upward, arrows fly straight and you fall softly. When it closes, everything comes down.
edict.afterworld.weightlessness.hint: Fields where stones float as if they forgot which way is down.
edict.afterworld.weightlessness.limit: Bounded radius and duration. Heavy creatures resist being lifted.
edict.afterworld.weightlessness.rule: Gravity forgets a small place for a while.
edict.afterworld.witness.capstone: Rank III: witnessed foes take 25% more harm for 15 seconds, and chests and ores within 48 blocks shine.
edict.afterworld.witness.desc: Every creature within thirty-two blocks glows, chests and spawners pulse with light, and your nearest lead flares in its direction.
edict.afterworld.witness.hint: Clearings where you feel watched by something taking notes.
edict.afterworld.witness.limit: A glimpse, not a map: ten seconds of sight.
edict.afterworld.witness.rule: Nothing near you may go unseen.
gadget.afterworld.grapple.desc: Fire at any surface within 32 blocks and be hauled there. No fall damage on the way.
gadget.afterworld.sextant.desc: Sight the nearest landmark and mark it on your map.
gadget.afterworld.skyward.desc: Ring it and the air throws you high into the sky; you drift down slowly after.
gadget.afterworld.whistle.desc: Calls your Duskstrider, a stag of the dusk roads that only you may ride.
gadget.afterworld.wing.desc: Use in mid-air for a few seconds of clumsy flight.
garb.afterworld.cat.head: Head
gift.afterworld.climb.desc: Climb faster and for longer: the claws take half the strain.
gift.afterworld.climb.how: Anyone can climb: jump at a wall and keep pushing into it. WASD moves along the wall, jump leaps up it, back and jump kicks off, sneak lets go. With the claws it is faster and costs half the stamina.
gift.afterworld.climb.short: Climb as usual; the claws do the rest.
gift.afterworld.double_jump.how: Press jump in mid-air to jump again.
gift.afterworld.glide.desc: Hold jump while falling to glide. Drains stamina slowly.
gift.afterworld.glide.how: Hold jump while falling to glide; look down to dive faster.
gift.afterworld.label: Gift: use it once to learn its ability for good.
gift.afterworld.water_walk.desc: Sprint across water as if it were stone. Drains stamina.
gift.afterworld.water_walk.how: Sprint onto water to run across it.
growth.afterworld.ready: It hums: Marta can wake it at her anvil.
item.afterworld.amulet_of_quiet_steps.de: While crouched, creatures more than eight blocks away lose track of you.
item.afterworld.angler_lure.lore: It still glows. Selene thinks it is a fallen star the sea kept.
item.afterworld.anomaly_residue.lore: Glittering dust left where a rule came loose.
item.afterworld.apologetic_blade.effect: Counterattacks after a perfect shield parry.
item.afterworld.apologetic_blade.lore: Its spirit is very sorry about all of this.
item.afterworld.ashen_warbanner.lore: Carried at the last stand of the Ashen Guard. It still smoulders.
item.afterworld.bell_fragment.lore: It still hums when nobody is listening.
item.afterworld.bell_rope.lore: Rotted at one end. It hums when held.
item.afterworld.boar_tusk.lore: Curved and heavy. Marta makes gauntlets of them.
item.afterworld.bog_amber.lore: Fen resin with old things caught inside. Smiths use it as flux.
item.afterworld.bogiron_crossbow.desc: Bolts poison what they hit, and the poison spreads to anything standing beside it.
item.afterworld.bogiron_crossbow.lore: Its bolts are soaked in lurker venom.
item.afterworld.bounty_writ.lore: A Warden's contract, signed and sealed.
item.afterworld.brassmere_repeater.desc: Three thunderous rounds (%s / %s loaded), then a reload that costs one gunpowder.
item.afterworld.brassmere_repeater.lore: Captain Odo's pride: three shots and a great deal of noise.
item.afterworld.caravan_seal.desc: Guild merchants give you fifteen in the hundred off.
item.afterworld.challenge_lantern.lore: Akane's token. Set it on the heart of the Lantern Dojo to wake the Ashen Shogun.
item.afterworld.chronicle_page.lore: Blank, for now. The world will write on it.
item.afterworld.clockwork_curio.lore: A small machine that does one useless thing beautifully.
item.afterworld.clockwork_fragment.lore: Still ticking. Not obviously connected to anything.
item.afterworld.clockwork_heart.lore: Winds itself on every blow you take. Release a charge to slow everything thrown at you.
item.afterworld.clockwork_heart.lore2: It overheats if wound and released too quickly.
item.afterworld.copper_mark.lore: The Guild's smallest coin. Worth one Mark.
item.afterworld.crab_shell.lore: Crystal grows on it. Glyphmail is backed with it.
item.afterworld.crimson_requiem.lore: The Crimson Lich's scythe. It remembers everyone it has reaped.
item.afterworld.crypt_key.lore: Fits one door in the Bonewood crypts.
item.afterworld.dunewalkers_chain.lore: A link of the Dune Sentinel's chains. It still wants to drag.
item.afterworld.dusk_fang.lore: A hound's fang, faintly violet. Wayfarers carve knives from them.
item.afterworld.duskpine_longbow.desc: Fully drawn arrows become Moonshots: they glow and curve toward foes. Hits harder as it grows.
item.afterworld.duskpine_longbow.lore: Strung with moth silk. It sings when drawn.
item.afterworld.echo_essence.lore: A held breath of the half-step behind the world.
item.afterworld.echo_shell.desc: Weapon Arts recover a fifth faster.
item.afterworld.edict_fragment.hint: Use to bind this rule to yourself.
item.afterworld.edict_shard.lore: A splinter of a rule. Raises an Edict's rank (Character screen, K).
item.afterworld.ember_chitin.lore: A plate of beetle shell that never quite cools.
item.afterworld.ember_core.lore: The coal at the heart of an Ashen Husk. It is still warm.
item.afterworld.ember_glass.lore: Glass that never quite cools. Bog folk want it for their lamps.
item.afterworld.ember_pepper.lore: Strength, and a mouth full of fire.
item.afterworld.emberheart_pendant.desc: Your blows set foes alight, and fire hurts you half as much.
item.afterworld.expedition_journal.lore: Edicts, rumours, the Chronicle and the Codex.
item.afterworld.frost_silk.lore: Spun by rime moths. Desert tailors would trade water for it.
item.afterworld.gear_spring.lore: The mainspring of a Gearhound, still trying to unwind.
item.afterworld.gearsprung_anklet.desc: A spring in your step: you jump higher, fall further unhurt, and the hook recovers faster.
item.afterworld.glimmerfin_bucket.lore: A little school of light, carried home.
item.afterworld.glimmerfin_scale.desc: In water you breathe freely and swim like a glimmerfin.
item.afterworld.glimmerfin_sushi.lore: Breathe and swim like a fish.
item.afterworld.glyph_gold.lore: Gold that carries a carved rule in its grain.
item.afterworld.glyph_tablet.lore: Carved with a rule of the Gilded Warden's court. Five of them open its vault.
item.afterworld.glyphwarden_aegis.lore: A shell-plate of the Gilded Warden, carved with judgment.
item.afterworld.gold_crown.lore: A hundred Marks. Merchants bite it anyway.
item.afterworld.grave_wax.lore: The Morrow Court seals its records with it.
item.afterworld.hearty_stew.lore: Bram's recipe. Two extra hearts for five minutes.
item.afterworld.hitodama.lore: The Ashen Shogun's blade. Its cuts burn with ghost-light.
item.afterworld.hungry_lantern.lore: Lit, it reveals invisible creatures and old traces.
item.afterworld.hungry_lantern.lore2: It feeds on your experience while it burns.
item.afterworld.kitsune_tail.lore: It is still warm. Foxfire flickers at its tip.
item.afterworld.living_crystal.lore: A shard of a Shardling that has not yet noticed it is broken.
item.afterworld.lucky_sextant.desc: More Marks from every purse, and the Survey Sextant recovers twice as fast.
item.afterworld.lurker_fang.lore: Hooked backward, so nothing it holds slips free.
item.afterworld.lynx_pelt.lore: Soft, grey and silent. The rangers' leathers are made of it.
item.afterworld.mirror_salt.lore: Salt from the mirror flats. It keeps meat and secrets.
item.afterworld.mirrorglass_chakram.lore: Thrown, it finds every face in the room.
item.afterworld.moonberry_tart.lore: You see in the dark and walk quicker.
item.afterworld.moonsilver_ingot.lore: Smiths say it remembers the shape it was given.
item.afterworld.moonsilver_rapier.lore: A duellist's blade, cold as a winter moon.
item.afterworld.moth_dust.lore: Scales from wings that prefer the dark.
item.afterworld.mothlantern_locket.desc: A moth's light lets you see in the dark.
item.afterworld.narwhal_tusk.lore: A spiral of ivory as long as a spear.
item.afterworld.pale_ectoplasm.lore: What remains of a shade. It is cold and remembers something.
item.afterworld.phylactery_shard.lore: A sliver of the Crimson Lich's vessel. It beats.
item.afterworld.pilgrim_offering.lore: A candle, a flower and a stone, tied with string. Mends a pilgrim shrine.
item.afterworld.pilgrims_bead.desc: Every move costs a fifth less stamina.
item.afterworld.ram_horn.lore: Ridged with years. Drums and gauntlets are made from them.
item.afterworld.raw_moonsilver.lore: Found in moonlit peaks. Cold to the touch even in the sun.
item.afterworld.rime_core.lore: The cold that a Rime Wight was built around. It frosts your fingers.
item.afterworld.rimeback_cleaver.lore: Cut from the Rimeback Colossus's horn.
item.afterworld.rimecore_charm.desc: You never freeze, and your blows slow what they strike.
item.afterworld.ring_of_second_breath.de: Once every ten minutes, a killing blow leaves you standing instead.
item.afterworld.ringers_ledger.lore: Candle accounts from the Hollow Cathedral.
item.afterworld.root_heartwood.lore: The living core of a rootling. It hums near waystones.
item.afterworld.sentinel_sandglass.desc: Your dodge stays untouchable for almost twice as long.
item.afterworld.shogun_steel.lore: Folded a thousand times in ghost-fire.
item.afterworld.shogun_tsuba.desc: Your parry window lasts much longer.
item.afterworld.sifter_mandible.lore: Sharp enough to cut glass. Desert smiths prize them.
item.afterworld.silver_mark.lore: Ten Marks, stamped with a waystone.
item.afterworld.sky_ambergris.lore: Shed by skywhales. Perfumers anywhere will buy it.
item.afterworld.skyhook_harpoon.lore: Made for skywhales. Works on walls.
item.afterworld.spice_crate.lore: Desert spice from the Hourglass Oasis. The cold peaks pay well for it.
item.afterworld.spiced_kebab.lore: Rashid's caravan fare. Quick hands, and the heat can't touch you.
item.afterworld.sporelash_whip.lore: Braided from fen roots. It leaves spores in every wound.
item.afterworld.star_chart_fragment.lore: Part of Selene's lost chart. Three make the whole.
item.afterworld.starlight_ink.lore: Ink that shows only by night. Cartographers fight over it.
item.afterworld.starlight_tea.lore: Selene's blend: you are Starlit for five minutes.
item.afterworld.starseed.desc: You are always Starlit: Resonance and stamina return faster.
item.afterworld.starweavers_wand.desc: Fires star bolts that lean toward foes. %s / %s charges; one returns every three seconds. Ascendant: bolts splinter.
item.afterworld.starweavers_wand.lore: Tipped with a star that refused to fall.
item.afterworld.sun_dial_key.lore: Opens the buried obelisk at noon.
item.afterworld.thimble_of_borrowed_rain: A tiny local rainstorm: waters crops, puts out fires, uncovers tracks.
Things that follow rain sometimes follow it.
item.afterworld.thunderdrum_gauntlets.lo: Clap them, and the sky answers.
item.afterworld.toad_oil.lore: The base of every oil and half of Mab's brews.
item.afterworld.torn_census.lore: A village census with pages missing.
item.afterworld.torn_map.lore: Someone else’s lead. Read it to make it yours.
item.afterworld.unfinished_compass.lore: Points toward the nearest unresolved rumour or hidden place.
item.afterworld.unfinished_compass.lore2: Sometimes it points to a clue, not a destination.
item.afterworld.wayfarers_fang.lore: A long knife for short arguments.
item.afterworld.windrider_feather.lore: The great eagle's flight feather. Odo would give a lot for one.
item.afterworld.wyrm_scale.lore: A wyrmling's scale, glowing at the edge.
journal.afterworld.arrived: You have reached the place it describes.
journal.afterworld.bearing: It lies to the %s, %s from here.
journal.afterworld.change_intro: Choose a new Discipline. The change costs 10 levels, and your signature will start cold.
journal.afterworld.choose_intro: Every traveller fights in their own way. Choose a Discipline: it grants a signature technique, a passive gift, and your first Edict. You can change it later, at a cost.
journal.afterworld.click_equip: Click to bind into the selected slot.
journal.afterworld.contract_tip.bureau: The Bureau pays, quietly, for anomalies sealed.
journal.afterworld.contract_tip.court: The Court asks that the forgotten be remembered.
journal.afterworld.contract_tip.crown: The Crown pays for marked beasts and safe roads.
journal.afterworld.contract_tip.guild: The Guild pays for places charted before anyone else finds them.
journal.afterworld.library_hint: Select a slot, then click a rule to bind it there.
journal.afterworld.missing_empty: No pages are missing. That you know of.
journal.afterworld.no_bonds: You have no Bonds. Some things in the world would like one.
journal.afterworld.no_rumours: No rumours yet. Sneak and right-click a villager to ask what they have heard, read a torn map, or ask a faction for work below.
journal.afterworld.page_torn: [the rest of this page is missing]
journal.afterworld.quote.chronicle: The world keeps its own account of what happened. So should you.
journal.afterworld.quote.codex: What you have learned about how this world bends.
journal.afterworld.quote.rumours: Every rumour points somewhere. Not every rumour points somewhere true.
journal.afterworld.quote.world: Four powers, one road, and a great many debts.
journal.afterworld.release_tip: Ending a Bond has a small, lingering consequence.
journal.afterworld.reliability.2: The rumour was out of date.
journal.afterworld.restore_tip: Chronicle Pages are found in old archives. Three restore a torn page, and anything torn with it.
journal.afterworld.take_up: Take up the way of the %s
journal.afterworld.track_tip: Witness, the Unfinished Compass and the Hungry Lantern point to the tracked rumour.
journal.afterworld.unknown_edict: An Edict you have not found.
journal.afterworld.wardrobe_tip: Change your garb and its colours.
ladder.afterworld.caught: The Ladder catches you and sets you back on the floor.
ladder.afterworld.echo.ashen_shogun: An echo of The Ashen Shogun bars the way
ladder.afterworld.echo.crimson_lich: An echo of The Crimson Lich bars the way
ladder.afterworld.echo.dune_sentinel: An echo of The Dune Sentinel bars the way
ladder.afterworld.echo.gilded_warden: An echo of The Gilded Warden bars the way
ladder.afterworld.echo.rimeback_colossus: An echo of The Rimeback Colossus bars the way
ladder.afterworld.echo_down: The echo fades. Floor %s is yours, and the way home is open.
ladder.afterworld.floor_won: Floor %s is won. The rung is lit.
ladder.afterworld.hud.cleared: Floor won: step onto the lit rung
ladder.afterworld.hud.title: Warden's Ladder
ladder.afterworld.landing: A landing: rest, trade, or go home
ladder.afterworld.legend_echo: Bested the echo of %s on floor %s of the Warden's Ladder
ladder.afterworld.legend_summit: Climbed all fifty floors of the Warden's Ladder
ladder.afterworld.rung_cold: The rung is cold. Win the floor first.
ladder.afterworld.screen.best_none: You have not climbed it yet.
ladder.afterworld.screen.gate_note: Everyone standing at the gate climbs together.
ladder.afterworld.screen.rule.echoes: Every tenth floor, an echo of one of the five Wardens holds the way.
ladder.afterworld.screen.rule.fall: Fall in the Ladder and it throws you out at its gate, alive.
ladder.afterworld.screen.rule.landings: Every fifth floor is a landing: rest, Rook's wares, and a way home.
ladder.afterworld.screen.rule.waves: Every floor sends waves of the land's creatures, stronger the higher you go.
ladder.afterworld.screen.subtitle: Fifty floors where the Wardens were proven
ladder.afterworld.screen.title: The Warden's Ladder
ladder.afterworld.summit.sub: Fifty floors. The Edict-writers would have made you a Warden.
ladder.afterworld.thrown.sub: You reached floor %s. The Ladder let you go; it keeps no one.
ladder.afterworld.wave_done: Wave %s of %s beaten. Catch your breath.
