loading.afterworld.tip.0: Rumours give a bearing and a distance, never an exact place. Follow the bearing, then look around.
loading.afterworld.tip.1: Every Edict has a rule and a limit. Learn the limit and the rule becomes a weapon.
loading.afterworld.tip.10: Some rumours are lies, and someone wanted them told.
loading.afterworld.tip.11: In a thunderstorm, look for lights where no village stood yesterday.
loading.afterworld.tip.2: Press J to open your Journal. The Chronicle remembers what happened while you were away.
loading.afterworld.tip.3: Settlements remember who helped them, and who did not.
loading.afterworld.tip.4: A Hospitality bargain holds only while you keep your hands to yourself.
loading.afterworld.tip.5: Borrowed Time rewinds your health and hunger, never your items.
loading.afterworld.tip.6: Struggling settlements wait for caravans. Unsafe roads stop them.
loading.afterworld.tip.7: The Pilgrim rarely strikes first. Ask what it wants before you ask how to kill it.
loading.afterworld.tip.8: Each ring of the Bell-Ringer's bell silences one of your Edicts. Count the rings.
loading.afterworld.tip.9: The Vault of Seconds learns how you fight. Change your habits and it has to change too.
lore.afterworld.alchemist_notes: The alchemist's notes: "Spore extract, toad oil, one glow berry: stamina for a day. Two berries: stamina for a week, then hiccups."
lore.afterworld.apprentice_note: A child's hand, waterlogged: "The tide took the bell. I kept the rope. One day I will ring it again, and finish the song."
lore.afterworld.astronomer: An astronomer's note: "The lenses wake in order, faintest first. Count the crystals on each plinth, then strike from fewest to most."
lore.afterworld.aurora_prayer: A prayer etched in the ice: "Three lights for the three colours of the sky. Light them and the sky will lend you one."
lore.afterworld.barrow_warning: Carved over the inner door: "HERE THE RED KING KEEPS A PIECE OF HIMSELF. LET IT LIE."
lore.afterworld.barrow_warning.short: Read the warning in the barrow.
lore.afterworld.catacomb_epitaph: An epitaph cut by the tomb door: "Four of his captains lie at the four ends. While their candles are cold, he keeps his treasure. Light them, and he will let it go."
lore.afterworld.cult_orders: Orders, written in soot: "Hold the tower. The ash remembers. When the Lich wakes, we will be the first to kneel."
lore.afterworld.dojo_rule: A scroll by the door: "Here the blade is only lifted to turn another aside. Bow when you enter. Bow when you leave."
lore.afterworld.druid_rite: A rite carved on the altar: "Count the flames on the stones, and strike them as the flames count: one, two, three, four."
lore.afterworld.fae_bargain: A note tied with a ribbon: "Light the ring at dusk and ask nicely. The fae keep what is buried, but they love a lit candle."
lore.afterworld.fae_bargain.short: Read a note about the fae ring.
lore.afterworld.forge_ledger: The forge-master's ledger, its last page scorched: "Fourth fire banked for the night. The vault is shut until all four burn at once; that is the old rule, and the old rule kept us honest. If you read this, light them for us."
lore.afterworld.geode_survey: A surveyor's notebook: "The geode rings to the touch. Four pylons round the platform, one crystal to four. Struck in the wrong order, they only hum. From the fewest to the most, and the case opens."
lore.afterworld.harp_carving: Carved on the cairn: "The harp sings low to high. Strike its posts from the shortest to the tallest."
lore.afterworld.harp_carving.short: Read the carving on the cairn.
lore.afterworld.hermit_diary: The hermit's diary: "Year 12. A traveller came by. I hid. Year 13. Another. Hid again. This is going well."
lore.afterworld.hermit_spores: A hermit's notes, written small: "The Heart wakes when it is struck, and everything that grows down here comes to defend it. Stand your ground and it tires, and the stems part. I only ever took what I needed."
lore.afterworld.hermit_spores.short: Read the hermit's notes on the Mycelium Heart.
lore.afterworld.keeper_log: The keeper's last log: "The light went out the night the bell rang under the sea. I can't keep it lit. It doesn't want to be."
lore.afterworld.kiln_foreman: The foreman's log: "Kilns three and four cracked again. The vault seal only turns when all four burn at once. Fussy thing."
lore.afterworld.ladder_gate: A tablet at the Ladder's foot: "FIFTY RUNGS. FIFTY PROOFS. THE WARDENS CLIMBED IT ONCE. CLIMB, AND BE WEIGHED."
lore.afterworld.ladder_gate.short: Read the tablet at the Ladder's gate.
lore.afterworld.ladder_landing: A note pinned by the fire: "Rook's Landing. Fair prices, warm fire, no refunds. If you see me on the floor above, no you didn't."
lore.afterworld.ladder_landing.short: Read the note at the landing.
lore.afterworld.lantern_grove: A child's writing on a board: "One candle each, and they sleep. Mama says not to forget the fifth."
lore.afterworld.lantern_grove.short: Read the board in the lantern grove.
lore.afterworld.mage_journal: A journal, frost on every page: "Day 40. Cannot keep all three hearths lit. The case at the top only opens to a warm tower. Day 41. Cold."
lore.afterworld.miner_tally: A tally on the timber: dozens of marks, then a single word scratched deep: "LISTENING."
lore.afterworld.monk_koan: A koan carved by the path: "The bell is rung by the one who reaches it. The reaching is the ringing."
lore.afterworld.monk_koan.short: Read a koan at the monastery.
lore.afterworld.necropolis_decree: A decree on red vellum: "All who die within these walls belong to the King. All who live within them, will."
lore.afterworld.needle_base: Scratched at the foot of the spire: "Whoever reaches the top may keep what is there. Mind the wind."
lore.afterworld.needle_base.short: Read the scratching at the Needle's foot.
lore.afterworld.needle_top: A note weighted with a stone: "You made it! The view is the real prize. The chest is the other real prize."
lore.afterworld.needle_top.short: Read the note at the top of the Needle.
lore.afterworld.nomad_song: A song stitched into a felt hanging: "Ride till the grass ends. Then ride till the sky ends. Then come home."
lore.afterworld.obelisk_hideout: Scratched in the wall, fresh: "Eight of us. Water for six days. The storm-eaters cannot smell us down here. — L."
lore.afterworld.orchard_gardener: A gardener's note: "Plant them deep, water them with candle-wax, and do not stay after dark."
lore.afterworld.ossuary_ledger: A ledger of the dead, one name per bone. The last page reads: "And one more, that will not stay counted."
lore.afterworld.proving_ring: Cut into a post: "THE RING REMEMBERS EVERY ONE WHO HELD IT. STRIKE THE STONE. STAND YOUR GROUND."
lore.afterworld.proving_ring.short: Read the post at the proving ring.
lore.afterworld.rimeback_tracks: Footprints wide as a cart, pressed deep into the snow and heading north. Whatever made them has not finished growing.
lore.afterworld.star_chart: A burnt star chart, one star circled: "Fell here. Still warm after a year. Do not touch the core with bare hands."
lore.afterworld.sun_dial: Carved round the dial: "Count the suns at each mirror's foot. Wake them from the least to the most, and the light will find the sleeper."
lore.afterworld.tea_poem: A poem on rice paper: "Boil the water. Wait. Pour. The blossom does not hurry, and still it falls in time."
lore.afterworld.temple_keeper: A keeper's tablet, green with age: "When the fen rises, light the four fires of the sanctum, so the Warden's glyph may be carried out dry."
lore.afterworld.trader_ledger: The traders' ledger, last entry: "Storm in the morning. Tents up. Sold nothing. Something circling the camp. Will try for the pass."
lore.afterworld.vault_inscription: Above the gate: "FIVE LANDS, FIVE GLYPHS. SET THEM HERE AND BE JUDGED."
lore.afterworld.watch_log: The watch log: "Day 9. Lights on the ice to the north. Day 10. They came closer. Day 11. Leaving the lockbox. Will come back."
lore.afterworld.weaver_victim: A note pinned by a web: "If you find this, I went in after the shine at the back. Do not."
lore.afterworld.weaver_victim.short: Found a note in the webs.
lore.afterworld.ziggurat_explorer: An explorer's note: "Four braziers on the summit, all cold. The carvings show them burning together, and a door opening in the floor."
lore.afterworld.ziggurat_explorer.short: Read an explorer's note on the ziggurat.
message.afterworld.anomaly_hint: A loose rule hums inside: %s. Break the core to seal it, or tap it with a glass bottle.
message.afterworld.anomaly_inert: The core is quiet. Whatever rule it held has been settled.
message.afterworld.anomaly_near: The air near %s obeys a different rule.
message.afterworld.anomaly_spill: The anomaly spills over. Its Edict tears free, and the strangeness spreads.
message.afterworld.aspect_known: You have already bound that Aspect.
message.afterworld.bond_cannot_pay.landl: You need 3 emeralds for the rent.
message.afterworld.bond_cannot_pay.moth: The moth wants 2 glowstone dust or 4 torches.
message.afterworld.bond_cannot_pay.pilgr: Stand at a mended shrine to keep this bond.
message.afterworld.bond_full: You cannot hold more than two Bonds.
message.afterworld.bond_offer.landlord: Mr. Hollowell, late of the Morrow Court, would like a tenant. He has a room. He would very much prefer you didn't die in it.
message.afterworld.bond_offer.moth: Something soft lands on your lantern and does not leave. It is hungry, and it has decided you are where food comes from.
message.afterworld.bond_offer.pilgrim: The stone pilgrim kneels. Its footsteps, it seems, would like to walk with you.
message.afterworld.bond_offer_hint: Open your Expedition Journal (World tab) to accept or decline.
message.afterworld.bond_overdue.landlord: Your rent is overdue. Something has started knocking on the walls at night.
message.afterworld.bond_overdue.moth: The moth is hungry. It has started eating the light around you.
message.afterworld.bond_overdue.pilgrim: It has been too long since you visited a shrine. Your feet feel heavy.
message.afterworld.bond_paid.landlord: Rent paid. Mr. Hollowell tips a hat that is not entirely there.
message.afterworld.bond_paid.moth: The moth eats, and the dark softens.
message.afterworld.bond_released.landlor: You give notice. A house you never saw groans as you leave it.
message.afterworld.bond_released.moth: The moth leaves, and takes a little light with it.
message.afterworld.bond_released.pilgrim: The road lets go of you.
message.afterworld.boon: %s sends a gift in recognition of your service.
message.afterworld.caravan_attack: The caravan is under attack! Keep the caravan master alive.
message.afterworld.caravan_lost: The caravan master is dead. The road will stay silent.
message.afterworld.chandelier_hit: The great chandelier comes down on the Bell-Ringer!
message.afterworld.chandelier_miss: The great chandelier crashes down onto the empty nave.
message.afterworld.contract_active: You already hold a contract from them.
message.afterworld.contract_full: You can carry %s contracts at once.
message.afterworld.contract_none: %s has no work for you right now.
message.afterworld.contract_none_here: No caravan needs you on these roads right now.
message.afterworld.contract_short: You do not have enough yet.
message.afterworld.contract_taken: Contract taken: %s. It is in your tracker.
message.afterworld.counterweight_spent: The counterweight has already been released.
message.afterworld.crow_full: The crow has nothing more to tell you today.
message.afterworld.discipline_chosen: You take up the way of the %s.
message.afterworld.dummy_hit: Too slow! Roll (Left Alt while moving) or parry (Left Alt standing still) as it swings.
message.afterworld.fail.borrowed_time_no: There is no time to borrow yet.
message.afterworld.fail.collision_cooldo: Both Edicts must be ready to collide.
message.afterworld.fail.collision_slots: Rule Collision needs Edicts in both of your first two slots.
message.afterworld.fail.empty_slot: No Edict is bound to that slot.
message.afterworld.fail.gambit: No foe within reach for the Gambit.
message.afterworld.fail.hospitality_none: There is no one to bargain with.
message.afterworld.fail.last_word: Last Word can only be spoken near defeat.
message.afterworld.fail.no_discipline: Choose a Discipline in your Expedition Journal first.
message.afterworld.fail.oathbreaker: No creature will bargain with an Oathbreaker.
message.afterworld.fail.return_nothing: Nothing of yours is close enough to return.
message.afterworld.fail.suppressed: The bell’s toll still silences that Edict.
message.afterworld.fail.trespass_none: There is no wall to pass through, or no room beyond it.
message.afterworld.fail.wrong_turn_far: Your mark is too far away.
message.afterworld.favour_collected: The Favour collects its interest: %s levels.
message.afterworld.favour_owed: You owe the Favour %s hostile kills within ten minutes.
message.afterworld.favour_paid: Your debt to the Favour is settled.
message.afterworld.fragment_shatter: You already hold %s. The fragment shatters into residue and insight.
message.afterworld.intro.2: Open your Expedition Journal (J) to choose a Discipline. Sneak and right-click a villager to ask what they have heard.
message.afterworld.intro.2b: Open your Expedition Journal (J) to see your Edicts and leads. Sneak and right-click a villager to ask what they have heard.
message.afterworld.king_bargained: The King of Seconds presses a fragment of himself into your hand, and is gone between one tick and the next.
message.afterworld.king_loop: Something marks where you stand. Be here when it comes due.
message.afterworld.king_loop_held: You held your ground in time.
message.afterworld.king_offer: "Enough." The King kneels. "I can spare you a second of mine, for my life." Hold a clock and sneak-use him to accept.
message.afterworld.king_refused: "So be it," says the King, and stands.
message.afterworld.king_rewound: The King of Seconds is on his throne again. "Did you think I could not rewind my own ending?"
message.afterworld.king_staggers: An escapement shatters. The King stumbles, out of time.
message.afterworld.king_wakes: The King of Seconds rises from his throne. "You are late. Everyone always is."
message.afterworld.lantern_hungry: The lantern is hungry, and you have nothing to feed it.
message.afterworld.lantern_starved: The lantern gutters out. It has eaten everything you had.
message.afterworld.mark_none: Nowhere like that is close enough to mark.
message.afterworld.need_pages: Restoring their history needs 3 Chronicle Pages.
message.afterworld.no_aspect: You have bound no Aspect yet. The great powers carry them.
message.afterworld.oathbreaker: You broke the bargain. %s creatures remember, and you will not be trusted with another for a while.
message.afterworld.oil_gone: The oil has worn off your weapon.
message.afterworld.oil_how: Hold a weapon in your main hand and the oil in your off hand.
message.afterworld.pact: Bargain struck with %s creatures for %s seconds. Do not strike anything.
message.afterworld.pilgrim_opens: The Pilgrim pauses at %s. Something beneath the shrine opens.
message.afterworld.pilgrim_peace: The Pilgrim does not fight on a finished road.
message.afterworld.pilgrim_wakes: The Pilgrim stops walking, and turns toward you.
message.afterworld.purse_dropped: You dropped a purse of %s Marks where you fell.
message.afterworld.relics_full: All three relic slots are full. Take one off on the Character screen (K).
message.afterworld.repeater_powder: The Repeater needs gunpowder to reload.
message.afterworld.resonance_low: Resonance %s / 100. Fight well to fill it.
message.afterworld.restore_need: You need %s Chronicle Pages to restore this.
message.afterworld.rewind_refund: %s Edicts return with the time you borrowed.
message.afterworld.ringer_appears: Something heavy drags a bell across the nave.
message.afterworld.ringer_bell_lost: The Bell-Ringer has lost its bell. Without it, it is only angry.
message.afterworld.ringer_remembers: "%s," it says, as if tasting the word. "I rang for the dead, so they would be remembered. I forgot myself instead." It sets the bell down.
message.afterworld.ringer_topples: Weightless, the Bell-Ringer loses its footing!
message.afterworld.ringer_wrong_name: The Bell-Ringer does not answer to "%s". It answers with the bell.
message.afterworld.roadwright: The Road That Moves has stopped here for a while. The Roadwright is open for business.
message.afterworld.rumours_full: Your journal is full of unresolved leads. Settle or abandon some first.
message.afterworld.second_breath: The Ring of Second Breath holds you up.
message.afterworld.settlement_raid: Something is moving at the edge of %s tonight.
message.afterworld.settlement_welcome: %s welcomes you like an old friend.
message.afterworld.shop_refused: %s will not trade with you right now.
message.afterworld.shrine_cracked: The shrine stone is cracked. A Pilgrim Offering would mend it.
message.afterworld.shrine_whole: The shrine is whole, and warm to the touch.
message.afterworld.slots_full: Your Edict slots are full. Rearrange them in the Expedition Journal.
message.afterworld.tenancy: "Not on my premises," says a voice like a door in a draught. You are still standing.
message.afterworld.thimble_follower: Something that follows the rain has found you.
message.afterworld.travel_dimension: A waystone only reaches across its own world.
message.afterworld.travel_no_camp: There is no camp to return to in this world.
message.afterworld.travel_wait: The waystone is still humming. Try again in %ss.
message.afterworld.unremembered_appear: Lights come on in %s, in houses that have no roofs.
message.afterworld.vault_adapt.anchored: The Vault has noticed you lift its wardens. They are now chained to the floor.
message.afterworld.vault_adapt.expected: The Vault remembers which way you came last time. It is expecting you.
message.afterworld.vault_adapt.listening: The Vault has noticed you creep. It has hung bells.
message.afterworld.vault_adapt.mirrored: The Vault has noticed you favour the bow. Its wardens now carry mirrored shields.
message.afterworld.vault_adapt.spiked: The Vault has noticed you favour the blade. Its wardens are now covered in spikes.
message.afterworld.vault_adapt.warded: The Vault has noticed you walk through its walls. Some of them are now warded.
message.afterworld.vault_bell: A bell rings as you pass. The Vault knows where you are.
message.afterworld.vault_gate: Both clocks are wound. The warded gate grinds open.
message.afterworld.wing_ground: Jump first: the wing only works in the air.
message.afterworld.witness_shine: %s hidden things shine through the stone.
message.afterworld.wraith_steals: The Rule-Wraith steals %s for a while.
message.afterworld.wrong_turn_marked: Wrong Turn marked. Press your signature again to return here.
notice.afterworld.climb_help: Climbing: WASD along the wall, Jump to leap, Back+Jump to kick off, Sneak to let go
notice.afterworld.insight: +%s Insight (%s to spend on the skill tree)
notice.afterworld.interest: The Guild Ledger paid %s Marks in interest.
notice.afterworld.rumour_found: You found what the rumour described: %s
origin.afterworld.bureau_clerk.desc: You filed anomalies for the Bureau of Impossible Things until one of them filed you. Bureau agents trust your paperwork.
origin.afterworld.bureau_clerk.tagline: Somewhere, there is a form for this.
origin.afterworld.court_mourner.desc: The Morrow Court taught you the names of the departed. Its keepers welcome you, and the forgotten sometimes do too.
origin.afterworld.court_mourner.tagline: You remember the dead, so that they need not.
origin.afterworld.crown_squire.desc: You carried a banner for the Crown until the road carried you off. Crown folk still greet you as one of their own.
origin.afterworld.crown_squire.tagline: Sworn to a crown that may not remember you.
origin.afterworld.guild_cartographer.des: The Cartographers' Guild taught you to measure the world, and the world refuses to hold still. Guildsfolk trade with you on better terms.
origin.afterworld.guild_cartographer.tag: Every map is a promise someone else will break.
origin.afterworld.wanderer.desc: Nobody in particular. Every faction treats you as a curiosity rather than a rival, and you came well supplied.
origin.afterworld.wanderer.tagline: No banner, no debts, no map.
phylactery.afterworld.broken: The phylactery shatters with a sound like a held breath let go. (%s of 3)
phylactery.afterworld.legend: Shattered one of the Crimson Lich's phylacteries
quest.afterworld.obj.anomaly: Bring a loose Edict to heel
quest.afterworld.obj.bell: Silence the Bell-Ringer of the Hollow Cathedral
quest.afterworld.obj.colossus: Bring down the Colossus of the white waste
quest.afterworld.obj.contract: Finish a notice from the Warden's Board
quest.afterworld.obj.dodge: Roll clear of a blow (Left Alt)
quest.afterworld.obj.hunt: Thin the wilds: defeat hostile creatures
quest.afterworld.obj.king: Face the King of Seconds in his vault
quest.afterworld.obj.lich: End the Lich who will not stay dead
quest.afterworld.obj.parry: Parry a blow as it lands
quest.afterworld.obj.pilgrim: Bring the Pilgrim's walk to an end
quest.afterworld.obj.sentinel: Wake, and best, the Dune Sentinel
quest.afterworld.obj.shogun: Lay the Ashen Shogun to rest
quest.afterworld.obj.shrine: Find a shrine on the Pilgrim's road
quest.afterworld.obj.trade: Trade at a stall: sell, then buy
relic.afterworld.label: Relic: use to wear it (three slots; manage them on the Character screen).
screen.afterworld.bank.sub: Banked Marks are safe from death and earn 1%% a day.
screen.afterworld.waystones.hint: Choose a waystone to travel to.
screen.afterworld.waystones.none: You haven't touched any other waystones yet.
seal.afterworld.hint: A seal stone, carved shut. Something nearby must be set right first.
seal.afterworld.hint.aurora_candles: Three candles for the three colours of the sky.
seal.afterworld.hint.catacomb_candles: Four captains lie at the catacombs' four ends, their candles cold. Light all four.
seal.afterworld.hint.dojo_heart: The heart of the dojo. Set the challenge lantern here, and he will come.
seal.afterworld.hint.druid_stones: Count the flames on the standing stones, and strike them as the flames count.
seal.afterworld.hint.fae_candles: A ring of cold candles. The fae keep their gifts for those who light the way.
seal.afterworld.hint.forge_fires: Four cold braziers stand round the bridges. The vault opens only when all four fires burn at once.
seal.afterworld.hint.geode_pylons: Four pylons, one crystal to four. Strike their buttons from the fewest crystals to the most.
seal.afterworld.hint.grove_candles: Five candles for five who never came home. Light them, and they will rest.
seal.afterworld.hint.harp_posts: The harp sings low to high. Strike its posts from the shortest to the tallest.
seal.afterworld.hint.kiln_fires: Four kilns stand cold around this seal. Fire wakes the kiln-door, but only all at once.
seal.afterworld.hint.lamp_braziers: Four braziers round the great lamp, cold as the sea. Light them together, and the lamp will remember.
seal.afterworld.hint.mycelium_heart: The Mycelium Heart. Strike it, and everything that grows here comes to defend it: three waves. Hold, and the stems part.
seal.afterworld.hint.observatory_lenses: Four plinths of crystal. Wake the lenses from the faintest to the brightest.
seal.afterworld.hint.proving_ring: A horn-stone. Strike it, and the ring will test you: three waves of the land's creatures. Hold the ring, and the cist opens.
seal.afterworld.hint.sun_mirrors: Four mirrors round the sun-dial. Count the suns at each one's foot, and strike them from the least to the most.
seal.afterworld.hint.temple_braziers: Four braziers ring the sanctum, cold. The seal will turn when all four burn together.
seal.afterworld.hint.tower_hearths: Three hearths, three floors. Warm the whole tower and the case will thaw.
seal.afterworld.hint.vault_gate: The gate wants the five Glyph Tablets. Hold them and set them in.
seal.afterworld.hint.ziggurat_braziers: Four braziers on the summit. Fire on every corner, and the floor will open.
seal.afterworld.opened: Stone grinds on stone. The seal turns, and something opens.
seal.afterworld.ring.wakes: The ring wakes! Hold it through %s waves.
seal.afterworld.solved: The seal has turned. Whatever it kept is open.
set.afterworld.duskpine_ranger.bonus: Set: projectiles hit 30%% harder, you move 10%% faster and have 20 more stamina.
set.afterworld.emberforged.bonus: Set: fire and lava can't hurt you, and whatever strikes you catches fire.
set.afterworld.gilded_glyphmail.bonus: Set: a quarter of all arrows and spells are turned aside, and +2 hearts.
set.afterworld.label: %s (%s/4)
set.afterworld.rimeguard.bonus: Set: cold can't touch you, attackers are slowed and chilled, +2 armour toughness.
set.afterworld.starweave.bonus: Set: Edicts recover a fifth faster, and you see in the dark.
set.afterworld.wardens_regalia.bonus: Set: Resonance builds a quarter faster, and you are hard to knock back.
shop.afterworld.haggle.jealous.2.lose: "Go, then. See if I care." They clearly care.
shop.afterworld.haggle.shrewd.1.win: They respect a hard bargain. Hands shake.
shop.afterworld.haggle.vain.0.win: They preen. "Well. For someone with taste..."
shop.afterworld.haggled_already: You've already haggled with them today.
shop.afterworld.hint: Prices move with demand. Sell what they lack, buy what's plentiful.
shop.afterworld.no_buyback: Nothing you sold is waiting here.
shop.afterworld.pick: Pick something to see it up close.
shop.afterworld.pick_sell: Pick something from your pack to sell.
side.afterworld.bell.0: Find the drowned chapel's bell rope.
side.afterworld.bell.1: Listen to the bell's song and play it back.
side.afterworld.brew.0: Bring Mab three lurker fangs, bog amber and two pinches of moth dust.
side.afterworld.brew.1: Brew the draught at Mab's cauldron.
side.afterworld.brew.2: Drink the draught and cross the black water.
side.afterworld.caravan.0: Search the wrecked caravan for clues.
side.afterworld.caravan.1: Find the caravan folk where they hid.
side.afterworld.duel.0: Face Akane in the duel of lanterns.
side.afterworld.edges.0: Survey three landmarks with Wren's sextant.
side.afterworld.forge.0: Fight with a growing weapon until it hums.
side.afterworld.hunt.0: Follow the trail Torvald showed you.
side.afterworld.hunt.1: Tell Torvald the beast is dead.
side.afterworld.hunt.2: Best Torvald at the archery butts.
side.afterworld.meal.0: Bring Bram two beef, three carrots, two potatoes and an ember core.
side.afterworld.meal.1: Cook the stew at Bram's pot.
side.afterworld.meal.2: Deliver the stew to the camp.
side.afterworld.stars.0: Find three star chart fragments for Selene.
side.afterworld.stars.1: Align the star dials with Selene at night.
side.afterworld.wayfarer.0: Bring Odo six gear springs and two clockwork fragments.
side.afterworld.wayfarer.1: Race the Wayfarer's rings for Odo.
skill.afterworld.arcanum.echo.desc: Every Edict you speak gives your Aspect 5 Resonance.
skill.afterworld.arcanum.overflow.desc: Unleashing an Aspect leaves a quarter of its Resonance.
skill.afterworld.blade.bloodthirst.desc: Killing blows struck by hand mend 2 health.
skill.afterworld.blade.duelist.desc: Hits on a foe that has chosen you deal 15%% more.
skill.afterworld.blade.execution.desc: Hits on foes below a quarter of their health deal 40%% more.
skill.afterworld.blade.flow.desc: Each hit in a row on the same foe deals 4%% more, up to 20%%.
skill.afterworld.blade.riposte.desc: Your parry window lasts longer, and a perfect parry cuts the attacker.
skill.afterworld.bridge.pilgrim.desc: Edicts recover 3%% faster. Joins Wayfarer to Arcanum.
skill.afterworld.bridge.spellblade.desc: Melee hits deal 3%% more damage. Joins Blade to Arcanum.
skill.afterworld.root.desc: Where every traveller begins. The tree grows from here.
skill.afterworld.wayfarer.featherfall.de: Falls hurt you half as much.
skill.afterworld.wayfarer.ghoststep.desc: Dodges cost 30%% less stamina and leave you quick for a second.
skill.afterworld.wayfarer.pathfinder.des: Move 15%% faster when nothing hunts you, and waystones recover twice as fast.
skill.afterworld.wayfarer.scavenger.desc: Foes you slay drop a quarter more Marks.
skill.afterworld.wayfarer.secondwind.des: When your stamina runs dry, half of it comes back at once (once in 30 seconds).
skilltree.afterworld.hint: Drag to look around  ·  Scroll to zoom  ·  Click a glowing node to learn it  ·  R to centre
skilltree.afterworld.need_path: Learn a node next to it first
skilltree.afterworld.title: Skill Tree
title.afterworld.region.ashen_moor: Where the old fires never quite went out
title.afterworld.region.bone_shore: The tide leaves bones; the bones stay
title.afterworld.region.duskpine_weald: Dark pines, soft moss, and lights left burning by no one
title.afterworld.region.echo_hollows: Every sound down here happens twice
title.afterworld.region.ember_steppe: The grass remembers a fire that has not happened yet
title.afterworld.region.frostmere_pines: The snow keeps what the pines forget
title.afterworld.region.glimmerfrost: Under the snow, something is still glowing
title.afterworld.region.gloamfen: Follow the lights at your own risk
title.afterworld.region.gloomwald: Even the mushrooms have stopped waiting for morning
title.afterworld.region.hollowwood: The trees here are older than the roads
title.afterworld.region.hourglass_dunes: Every grain is a second somebody borrowed
title.afterworld.region.mirrordeep: Somewhere below, the reflections keep going
title.afterworld.region.mirrorsea: Calm enough to show you the sky twice
title.afterworld.region.mossmere_wood: Old trees, older moss, and nobody keeping count
title.afterworld.region.pale_reach: The Court buries names here, and the trees remember them
title.afterworld.region.petalfall: It has been spring here for a very long time
title.afterworld.region.rimedeep: The cold goes all the way down
title.afterworld.region.rimefloe: The sea froze here, and never thawed
title.afterworld.region.rimeglass_spires: The ice grows upward, as if it were reaching
title.afterworld.region.rimesea: Cold, clear water, and icebergs drifting like ships
title.afterworld.region.rootways: The roots of the Hollowwood go deeper than you think
title.afterworld.region.rustscar_canyons: The rock bleeds copper where the rules were cut
title.afterworld.region.shardfields: Here, stones forget which way is down
title.afterworld.region.silverrun: Rivers that remember where they came from
title.afterworld.region.skyspire_peaks: Above the clouds, the rules thin out
title.afterworld.region.sporeveil: Breathe lightly; the island is listening
title.afterworld.region.verdant_tangle: The forest grew over the Archive, and kept reading
title.afterworld.region.vesper_downs: Where the evening is always just beginning
title.afterworld.region.whitewaste: Something enormous died here, and the cold kept it
title.afterworld.region.windworn_highlan: The stones stand where the wind told them to
title.afterworld.site.anomaly: Here, a rule has come loose
title.afterworld.site.cathedral: Somewhere inside, a bell is still rung
title.afterworld.site.containment: Property of the Bureau of Impossible Things
title.afterworld.site.lair: Something has made its den here
title.afterworld.site.mausoleum: Where the Morrow Court keeps its names
title.afterworld.site.observatory: The Cartographers' Guild measures the sky
title.afterworld.site.shrine: A waypoint on the Pilgrim's road
title.afterworld.subtitle: The world that plays back
tooltip.afterworld.lost_purse: Holds %s Marks. Pick it up to take them back.
tooltip.afterworld.soulbound: ✦ Soulbound: stays with you through death
trial.afterworld.archery.hint: Shoot each target before it falls. Six of eight.
trial.afterworld.brewing.drop_good: In it goes. The brew drinks it up.
trial.afterworld.brewing.hint: Space: drop the next ingredient in when the brew turns its colour. A / D: stir with the bubbles.
trial.afterworld.brewing.murky: Murky. Mab will not be impressed.
trial.afterworld.brewing.unstirred: The bubbles settled on their own.
trial.afterworld.cooking.hint: Hold Space to stir and keep the heat in the green. Press 1-4 to add what the broth asks for.
trial.afterworld.cooking.missing: Bram counts on his fingers: two beef, three carrots, two potatoes, one ember core.
trial.afterworld.duel.hint: Only a perfect parry counts. Parry the instant her blade falls.
trial.afterworld.duel.struck: Struck! %s more and the duel is lost.
trial.afterworld.lose.escaped: The alpha got away. Torvald can show you the trail again.
trial.afterworld.lose.forfeit: You walked away from the duel. Akane will wait.
trial.afterworld.lose.lost: The snow filled the tracks. You've lost the trail. Torvald can show you again.
trial.afterworld.lose.missed: Not enough hits. Torvald will set the targets up again.
trial.afterworld.lose.score: Not quite. Talk to them again to try once more.
trial.afterworld.lose.struck: Her blade found you three times. Akane bows: again, when you are ready.
trial.afterworld.lose.time: The sand ran out. Talk to them again to try once more.
trial.afterworld.lose.wandered: You moved away from the waystone. Raise the sextant again beside it.
trial.afterworld.lose.wet: Splash. You're soaked through. Mab will let you try again.
trial.afterworld.melody.again: Not quite. She hums it again.
trial.afterworld.melody.finished: The song is finished. She can rest.
trial.afterworld.melody.hint: Listen, then ring the bells back in the same order with 1-5.
trial.afterworld.melody.verse: Yes. She hums the next verse.
trial.afterworld.race.hint: Hold Jump to glide; steer with your view. Through every ring before the sand runs out.
trial.afterworld.sighting.done: You've already taken a sighting at this waystone.
trial.afterworld.sighting.hint: Hold still. Let the needle settle.
trial.afterworld.smithing.hint: Space or click: strike while the marker sits in the gold.
trial.afterworld.smithing.not_ready: Marta squints at your weapon. "It isn't humming yet. Use it more."
trial.afterworld.smithing.woke: %s wakes, heavier in the hand and keener in the edge.
trial.afterworld.stars.hint: A / D to turn a star, W / S or 1-5 to choose one. Bring each home to its mark.
trial.afterworld.tracking.found: The tracks end. Something huge lifts its head.
trial.afterworld.tracking.hint: Follow the fresh tracks. Lose them, and you lose the alpha.
trial.afterworld.waterwalk.hint: Sprint across the water to the marker and back. Don't get wet.
wheel.afterworld.hint: Point at a rule and let go
wonder.afterworld.abandoned_mine.sub: They dug too deep, and something dug back.
wonder.afterworld.angels.sub: Told to watch, and never told to stop.
wonder.afterworld.aurora_shrine.sub: It holds a piece of the northern lights.
wonder.afterworld.barrow_mound.sub: Something inside is still keeping count.
wonder.afterworld.beached_wreck.sub: She came in on her side.
wonder.afterworld.bone_orchard.sub: Nothing grows here but what was planted.
wonder.afterworld.buried_obelisk.sub: Its shadow keeps the wrong hours.
wonder.afterworld.canopy_outpost.sub: Built where the jaguars can't reach.
wonder.afterworld.canyon_outpost.sub: A rope bridge and a long way down.
wonder.afterworld.cathedral.sub: A city that still keeps its evening bells.
wonder.afterworld.cinder_watchtower.sub: Its new tenants are not watching for you. Yet.
wonder.afterworld.citadel.sub: Its spires are older than the dark around them.
wonder.afterworld.climbers_needle.sub: Forty blocks of rock, and a flag at the top.
wonder.afterworld.colossus_graveyard.sub: Where the giants of winter lie down.
wonder.afterworld.crimson_necropolis.sub: Here the red king holds court with the dead.
wonder.afterworld.crystal_observatory.su: It watches the sky through lenses of living crystal.
wonder.afterworld.drowned_catacombs.sub: The dead here were buried with their lanterns.
wonder.afterworld.drowned_shrine.sub: The tide took the bell. Not the rope.
wonder.afterworld.ember_kilns.sub: Four cold mouths around a sealed door.
wonder.afterworld.frozen_mage_tower.sub: Its last tenant is still working, in a way.
wonder.afterworld.frozen_watch_post.sub: The watch ended. The view did not.
wonder.afterworld.geode_vault.sub: It rings when you speak in it.
wonder.afterworld.gilded_vault.sub: Five glyphs open it. One Warden keeps it.
wonder.afterworld.glowcap_hollow.sub: Something down there is breathing slowly.
wonder.afterworld.great_nest.sub: Something with a very large wingspan lives here.
wonder.afterworld.hanged_lanterns.sub: Five lights for five who never came home.
wonder.afterworld.hermits_bough.sub: He liked the view. And nobody.
wonder.afterworld.ladder_gate.sub: Fifty floors up, and none of them in this world.
wonder.afterworld.ladder_gate_first.sub: Fifty floors up, and none of them in this world.
wonder.afterworld.lantern_dojo.sub: Every lantern is a life he took.
wonder.afterworld.lighthouse.sub: The lamp went out the night the bell rang under the sea.
wonder.afterworld.lodge.sub: Smoke from the chimney, boots by the door.
wonder.afterworld.mill.sub: Where the Guild's airships come to drink.
wonder.afterworld.moonlit_clearing.sub: The fae keep their gifts for the patient.
wonder.afterworld.nomad_yurts.sub: Felt walls, warm fires, no maps.
wonder.afterworld.ossuary_gate.sub: A door made of everyone who came before.
wonder.afterworld.overgrown_ziggurat.sub: Every step was laid for a god.
wonder.afterworld.proving_ring.sub: Strike the stone, and hold the ring.
wonder.afterworld.rimeback_den.sub: The snow here is standing up.
wonder.afterworld.shattered_caravan.sub: The crystals grew through it overnight.
wonder.afterworld.snowbound_camp.sub: They meant to wait out the storm.
wonder.afterworld.star_spire.sub: It hums when the stars are out.
wonder.afterworld.starfall_crater.sub: It fell, and it is still warm.
wonder.afterworld.sun_temple.sub: Light, in the right order, wakes it.
wonder.afterworld.sunken_bog_temple.sub: The fen took it a stone at a time.
wonder.afterworld.sunken_forge.sub: The hammers stopped. The fires did not go out on their own.
wonder.afterworld.titan.sub: It knelt when the first rules were written.
